releases.summary: NASHVILLE, Tenn., Oct. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tim McGraw, Paul Overstreet and the Stanley Brothers were officially inducted into the Country Music Hall of Fame on Sunday, October 18, during the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum's 2026 Medallion Ceremony. But the multiplatinum singer, the ace songwriter, and the bluegrass music pioneers were connected long before they became the 159th, 160th and 161st Hall of Fame members together.
releases.title: Tim McGraw, Paul Overstreet, and the Stanley Brothers Join Country Music Hall of Fame in Emotional Medallion Ceremony
releases.body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn., Oct. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tim McGraw, Paul Overstreet and the Stanley Brothers were officially inducted into the Country Music Hall of Fame on Sunday, October 18, during the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum's 2026 Medallion Ceremony. But the multiplatinum singer, the ace songwriter, and the bluegrass music pioneers were connected long before they became the 159th, 160th and 161st Hall of Fame members together.

Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum CEO Kyle Young, who led the Medallion Ceremony, recounted in his remarks that McGraw arrived in Nashville at 1 a.m. on May 9, 1989, with a pawn shop guitar and an ambitious dream to make country music. Later that morning, the world learned that the young New Traditionalist singer Keith Whitley had died.

"Now, some people might call that a bad omen," McGraw said during his induction speech. "I've come to believe it was something else. I think Nashville was telling me the truth on my very first day: that this music costs something. The people who make it give everything that they've got. And if you're lucky enough to make it down the road, you owe it to the ones that didn't and the ones who paved it."

Whitley, a 2022 Country Music Hall of Fame inductee, was a student of bluegrass music. Early in his career, he started a band with 2018 inductee Ricky Skaggs that specialized in the repertoire of the Stanley Brothers. Whitley and Skaggs later became members of Ralph Stanley & the Clinch Mountain Boys. Only a few months before he died at age 34, Whitley earned his second #1 single with the song "When You Say Nothing at All," written by Overstreet and 2017 Hall of Fame inductee Don Schlitz.

"I don't believe that's coincidence — I believe that's country music," McGraw said. "It's a chain, and every link holds up the next one."

TIM MCGRAW

With an ear for memorable songs and a musical style that could be both tough and tender, Tim McGraw became one of the most versatile and recognizable country music stars in the 1990s and 2000s. After establishing his music career, he explored acting and landed leading roles in the Hollywood films "The Blind Side," "Country Strong" and "Friday Night Lights," and in the TV series "1883."

"Someday I hope some kid pulls into town with everything they own in a suitcase and a dream too big to fit in it. Maybe they'll hear one of my songs on the radio. And I hope it tells them what I learned from Keith: getting here comes with a cost," a visibly emotional McGraw said as he concluded his speech. "But standing here tonight, in front of all of you, in front of all of my heroes . . . in this moment, tonight, man, it's worth it."

McGraw's list of thank yous began with seven women who helped him reach this career pinnacle: his mother, Betty Ann D'Agostino Trimble; his wife, fellow country singer Faith Hill; his daughters, Audrey, Gracie and Maggie; and his sisters, Sandy and Tracey. Alabama member Randy Owen also focused on McGraw's roots while leading his induction.

"Home has never left his heart. Family has never left his heart. Country music has never left his heart," Owen said. "We're all so lucky that we can call him one of us."

Musical tributes to McGraw included Parker McCollum's heartfelt and faithful version of McGraw's first #1 single, 1994's "Don't Take the Girl"; a sweet rendition of McGraw's 1997 chart-topper, "Just to See You Smile," by Lainey Wilson, who grew up down the road from where McGraw was raised; and Lady A's take on "Live Like You Were Dying," arguably the night's most emotional performance. The trio's Charles Kelley, who was recently diagnosed with a rare blood cancer, sang lead with deep feeling and skill, and bandmates Dave Haywood and Hillary Scott elevated the award-winning crossover hit with their powerful harmony vocals.

"Hearing my songs sung back in your voices is such a strange and beautiful thing," McGraw told them all. "It's like . . . finding a letter you wrote a long time ago and learning it got to where it was going."

PAUL OVERSTREET

A master of catchy melodies and clever, concise wordplay, Paul Overstreet wrote some of the most popular and enduring songs of the 1980s and'90s, including 27 Top Ten country hits between 1981 and 1991 and 13 #1 hits overall. BMI named him Country Songwriter of the Year for an unprecedented five consecutive years (1987 to 1991), and the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame inducted him in 2003.

"Paul took his own ups and downs and turned them into three-minute messages of hope for millions of listeners — title by title, song by song, hit by hit," said Museum CEO Kyle Young. Overstreet's songs brought a modern perspective to time-tested themes: relationships, faith, family, the power of love to unify and heal — and, in the case of a Blake Shelton chart-topper, bad days. Before performing his 2004 single "Some Beach," Shelton told the crowd about how, as a teenager, he idolized Overstreet and, as an aspiring artist, hoped to one day record one of his songs.

"I never dreamed that my Paul Overstreet song would be a song called 'Some Beach,'" he said to laughter, "but damn it, I'm proud of it."

In addition to Shelton's performance, Country Music Hall of Fame member Dean Dillon delivered a song he wrote with Overstreet, "If I Could Bottle This Up," which George Jones recorded in 1988 with Shelby Lynne, while Jamey Johnson's deep and powerful voice proved a perfect match for Randy Travis's 1987 award-winning hit "Forever and Ever, Amen." Overstreet was inducted by Tanya Tucker — whose 1973 concert in Waco, Texas, persuaded Overstreet to move to Nashville to begin his career as a songwriter and singer. Tucker, who recorded Overstreet's composition "I Won't Take Less Than Your Love" with Overstreet and Paul Davis and scored a #1 country hit — praised the songwriter's talent and his heart.

"The brilliant songwriting of Paul Overstreet speaks for itself, but it's Paul Overstreet the friend and the brother that will always be dear to me," she said. In 1988, several months in a rehabilitation program left Tucker uncertain about her life and career, but when she heard "I Won't Take Less Than Your Love" on the radio after leaving the facility, she recalled, "It gave me something to live for and reminded me of the love of a friend that could and would last a lifetime."

THE STANLEY BROTHERS

Before Hall of Fame members Vince Gill and Ricky Skaggs performed the bluegrass standard "Rank Stranger" with guitarist Jeff White, Skaggs said there was nobody happier to see the Stanley Brothers join the Country Music Hall of Fame. Judging by the standing ovations and loud cheers from the crowd throughout the three-hour ceremony, however, that's debatable. Clearly, the induction of brothers Ralph and Carter Stanley, officially performed by Gill, was long awaited by many in attendance.

"This moment has been a lifetime in the making, and it is difficult to put into words what it means to see my father, alongside my Uncle Carter, honored in this way — just the way my daddy wanted it to be — both of them side by side," said Lisa Stanley Marshall, daughter of Ralph Stanley, who represented the Stanley family alongside her brother, Ralph Stanley II, and her cousin, Jeanie Stanley, Carter Stanley's daughter.

"They were the cream of the crop," Jeanie added, "and it has been a long time coming."

Two additional performances in the Stanleys' honor showed just how driving and high-spirited bluegrass can be. Billy Strings and his band earned a standing ovation for their high-octane take on "How Mountain Girls Can Love," full of fast-fingered solos. Similarly, the First Ladies of Bluegrass — Alison Brown, Becky Buller, Sierra Hull, Missy Raines and Molly Tuttle — dazzled with fiery solos on a brisk version of "Bound to Ride." They perform the song with Dolly Parton on a new Stanley Brothers tribute album and added the recordings of Parton's spirited interjections into their live performance.

"Ralph Stanley often rejected the word 'bluegrass' as means of describing the Stanley Brothers' music. It was 'old-time mountain music,' he said, and no one should dare challenge the good doctor on defining his own craft," Museum CEO Kyle Young said. "However, the acoustic instrumentation, the stark lyrics, [and] the blood-resonant harmonies all point to a definitive musical style that is as popular today, eighty years since its commercial inception, [as] ever before."

ABOUT THE MEDALLION CEREMONY

The annual Country Music Hall of Fame Medallion Ceremony is when the year's members-elect officially join their heroes, influences and peers as Hall of Fame members. The celebratory ceremony highlights each new member's talent, achievements and legacy through emotional speeches, surprise musical tributes and video biographies, and a current Hall of Fame member inducts each member-elect.

At the 2026 Medallion Ceremony, the museum's 31st, the Medallion All-Star Band backed many of the night's tribute performances. Led by musical director and acoustic guitarist Biff Watson, the group also included drummer Mark Beckett, keyboard player Jen Gunderman, harmony singer Tania Hancheroff, bassist Alison Prestwood, fiddler and mandolin player Deanie Richardson, pedal steel player Scotty Sanders, acoustic guitarist and harmony singer Jeff White and electric guitarist Charlie Worsham.

At the start of the night, attendees observed a moment of silence in honor of Dolly Parton and Don Schlitz, the two Country Music Hall of Fame members who died within the last year. Patty Loveless, who joined the Hall of Fame in 2023, closed the event with an upbeat performance of "Will the Circle Be Unbroken," altering the lyrics just slightly in tribute to Parton and Schlitz.

The Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum produces the Medallion Ceremony, and the Country Music Association — which elects new Country Music Hall of Fame members —underwrites the event with City National Bank. This is the museum's 31st Medallion Ceremony

About the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum: 

The Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum collects, preserves and interprets country music and its history for the education and entertainment of diverse audiences. In exhibitions, publications, digital media and educational programs, the museum explores the cultural importance and enduring beauty of the art form. Among the most-visited history museums in the United States, the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum was awarded the country's highest honor in the arts, the National Medal of Arts, in 2024. Accredited by the American Alliance of Museums, the museum is operated by the Country Music Foundation, a not-for-profit 501(c)(3) educational organization chartered by the state of Tennessee in 1964. The Country Music Foundation operates Historic RCA Studio B®, Hatch Show Print® poster shop, Haley Gallery, CMA Theater, CMF Records, the Frist Library and Archive and CMF Press. Museum programs are supported in part by Metro Arts and Tennessee Arts Commission.

More information about the Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum is available at www.countrymusichalloffame.org or by calling (615) 416-2001.

releases.title: TECNO and BBC StoryWorks Unveil New Film Exploring the Human Stories Behind "100 Portraits of Becoming"
releases.body:
As part of TECNO and artist Angélica Dass's global "100 Portraits of Becoming" project, the new BBC StoryWorks film reveals the personal journeys behind the portraits, bringing to life a shared vision of seeing beyond the image to understand the people behind it.

HONG KONG, Oct. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Global innovative technology brand TECNO has jointly produced and released a new film with  BBC StoryWorks to unveil the project of "100 Portraits of Becoming," a two-year global portrait project co-created by TECNO and internationally acclaimed visual artist Angélica Dass which started from Kenya as the first chapter. Building on TECNO's philosophy of inclusive imaging technology and Angélica Dass's distinctive approach to portraiture, the project plans to bring together 100 portraits and personal stories across five countries, moving beyond visual representation to explore the individuality and humanity behind each portrait. Through the personal journeys featured in the film, audiences gain a glimpse into the energy and aspirations of people navigating today's changing world — how they are finding their own paths, shaping new possibilities and imagining who they want to become.

The film also explores the shared vision behind TECNO's collaboration with Dass. While TECNO's Universal Tone technology seeks to fairly represent the beauty of different skin tones and human diversity, Dass's work has long challenged the labels and assumptions through which we see others. Together, they bring a shared belief to "100 Portraits of Becoming": that being seen is about more than appearance — it is also about being understood for who we are.

Through the film, this idea comes to life in Kenya, where the first chapter of "100 Portraits of Becoming" began. It introduces some of the people behind the portraits, each with a different story of finding their own way forward. For agripreneur Alex Mutua Muli, opportunity wasn't something to seek elsewhere, but something to create at home. By connecting local farmers to wider markets, he is helping build a future in the community where he grew up. Alexander Odhiambo took a different path, turning an uncertain start to his career into a new beginning. From a small apartment in Nairobi, he co-founded a software company that has since grown to serve markets across Africa, opening doors for others along the way. And for Jelimo Cheboi, what began as a small WhatsApp group became something much bigger. As co-founder of GirlSkate Nairobi, she has helped turn a shared passion for skateboarding into a growing community where girls and women can challenge expectations, find belonging, and express themselves on their own terms.

Their stories are different, but each challenges an assumption about what is possible — whether it is where opportunity can be found, what a career can become, or who gets to belong. Together, they offer a glimpse of the people behind the portraits, whose lives cannot be summed up by a single image or label.

"The beauty of this project was the chance to look beyond an image and let people tell their own stories. Through their passions and experiences, every person we met brought a vibrancy and depth to the film that a single portrait may not fully capture. We hope the film will encourage audiences to see people with a little more curiosity and a little more understanding," said Tom Deakin, Director, Content Strategy at BBC StoryWorks APAC.

"100 Portraits of Becoming" is a two-year global project bringing together 100 portraits and personal stories across Kenya, the Philippines, Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Brazil. Together, these portraits and stories will form a growing collection that celebrates the many different ways of being human — 100 people, 100 stories and 100 ways to see humanity. Following its first chapter in Kenya, the project will continue its journey to more countries around the world, uncovering new stories, experiences and perspectives on what it means to become. Stay tuned for more inspiring stories and the latest updates from "100 Portraits of Becoming" on the BBC StoryWorks project page and "100 Portraits of Becoming" by TECNO and Angelica Dass official website.

About TECNO

As a global innovative technology brand with operations in over 70 markets, TECNO has been committed to revolutionizing the digital experience in global emerging markets, relentlessly pushing for the perfect integration of contemporary, aesthetic design with the latest technologies and AI. TECNO offers a wide range of smartphones, smart wearables, laptops and tablets, smart gaming, HiOS operating systems and smart home products. Guided by its brand essence of "Stop At Nothing," TECNO is committed to unlocking the newest technologies and AI-powered new experiences for forward-looking individuals, inspiring them to never stop pursuing their best selves and their best futures. For more information, please visit TECNO's official site: www.tecno-mobile.com.

About "100 Portraits of Becoming" by TECNO and Angélica Dass

"100 Portraits of Becoming" is a global portrait project created by TECNO together with internationally recognized artist Angélica Dass. Over two years, it will produce one hundred portraits across five countries — Kenya, the Philippines, Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Brazil — pairing Dass's portrait methodology with TECNO's Universal Tone inclusive imaging technology. Each portrait moves beyond a face to the person behind it: to lives unfolding across different cultures, generations and moments of social change. One hundred portraits become one hundred ways of seeing humanity — and one growing archive of who we are, told by the people living it. To learn more, please visit: https://www.tecno-mobile.com/100portraitsofbecoming/.

releases.body:
Ole Smoky Roadshow Presents 'Moonshine & Music'

Tour Tickets Just $10, or Free at Ole Smoky Venues

By Any Means: The Album musical director Pynk Beard is on tour with album artists Steve Ray Ladson, Elsie, and Stella Prince — plus special guests Tone Stith, Reyna Roberts, 2'Live Bre, Tatiana Marie Clark in specific markets

Apple Music's ACM Award® recognized Color Me Country Radio host Rissi Palmer to select a local opening act at each show

Tour follows By Any Means artists playing their acclaimed State Fair of Texas arena show

ST. LOUIS, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Anzie Blue Records and Ole Smoky Distillery today announced a 7-date coast to coast "Moonshine & Music" tour behind By Any Means: The Album, featuring musical director Pynk Beard and album artists Steve Ray Ladson, Elsie, and Stella Prince; plus special guests in various markets. In the spirit of moonshine and music bringing people together, tickets cost just $10 — and Ole Smoky is rolling out free entrance at their Nashville and Myrtle Beach distillery locations. Visit this site for tickets: https://www.anzieblue.com/tour

The show will spotlight the beloved '60s soul classics covered on By Any Means: The Album — featuring music from and inspired by the feature film BY ANY MEANS, starring Mark Wahlberg and Yahya Abdul-Matteen II — plus the original title track written by 17-time Oscar® nominee Diane Warren, performed by Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees The Isley Brothers and Nashville singer-songwriter David Kushner. "By Any Means" is widely predicted to be a 2027 Academy Award® nominee for Best Original Song, including by outlets like Variety, TheWrap, and all 4 critics in Awards Watch's 2027 Oscars predictions: https://awardswatch.com/2027-oscar-predictions-all-below-the-line-and-feature-categories/

Ole Smoky Distillery is the marketing partner for By Any Means: The Album and the Moonshine & Music Tour. CEO Mike Novy says, "At Ole Smoky, we believe great music is meant to be shared. That's why we're proud to support emerging artists through this 7-city tour, giving fans the chance to discover new stars while celebrating some of the songs that have shaped American music. Whether it's gathering around a stage or sharing a jar of Ole Smoky, we're all about creating moments that bring people together."

The Moonshine & Music Tour will play 7 cities with substantial Black music history: St. Louis, Nashville, New Orleans, Atlanta, Jacksonville, Myrtle Beach, and Los Angeles. Opening the tour in St. Louis is significant, as the Gateway City is home to "By Any Means" title track performers The Isley Brothers, whose breakout hit "Shout" was released in 1959. Jacksonville is where Ray Charles — whose "Hit the Road Jack" and "Georgia On My Mind" are covered on the album by Brandy & Pynk Beard and 2'Live Bre & The BoykinZ, respectively — began his performing career at age 15, including at the Ritz Theatre.

Apple Music's Color Me Country Radio host Rissi Palmer selected a local opening act at every show. Palmer — who received the Academy of Country Music's 2024 ACM Lift Every Voice Award — remarks "Color Me Country Radio and The Color Me Country Foundation are so proud to have handpicked each of the openers for this tour. I believe in lifting up my peers through grants and opportunities, and this partnership with Anzie Blue Records and Ole Smoky Distillery has made that mission possible with this historic and culturally significant tour. Y'all are in for a soulful and joyful experience!"

By Any Means: The Album was released on September 25, and its Special Edition vinyl is available for pre-order now here: https://theorchard.indiemerch.com/collections/anzie-blue/products/by-any-means-the-album?variant=67649569292470 The album is executive produced by Surf Club co-founder Hit-Boy, whose extensive production credits include Beyoncé, Jay-Z, Travis Scott and Drake, and Dr. Blum, whose credits include Twenty One Pilots, Big Sean and Nas. Parasol Music, co-founded by Martin Wave, served as a creative and production partner on the album.

Musically directed by Anzie Blue Records country artist and GRAMMY® nominated songwriter Pynk Beard, By Any Means: The Album brings together artists across generations and genres to reinterpret songs connected to the sound and spirit of the 1960s. Brandy, Kashus Culpepper, Keb' Mo', Tone Stith, and others put their own stamp on songs from iconic artists — including a dozen Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees, with three in the Rock Hall's premiere induction class: Ray Charles, Sam Cooke, and James Brown. The "By Any Means" original title track makes The Isley Brothers the latest of more than 40 Rock Hall inductees to release a Diane Warren composition.

Much of the album was recorded at FAME Studios in Muscle Shoals, Alabama in less than a week — bringing the project to a place with deep roots in American soul music and to Pynk Beard's home state.

The official "By Any Means" music video, featuring The Isley Brothers and Kushner, was released September 4. Watch here: https://youtu.be/pZaWebkmJDY Directed by Fran Strine of F26 Productions — who directed Dolly Parton's Live at London O2 Arena film — the video was followed on September 25 by Pynk Beard's "We Shall Overcome," also directed by Strine: https://youtu.be/iRaA3oz8U44 Strine is directing an upcoming music video for "Bring It on Home to Me" with Keb' Mo and Pynk Beard.

Net proceeds from By Any Means: The Album benefit the Black Music Action Coalition (BMAC), supporting the organization's work to advance equity, expand opportunity, and create pathways for the next generation of artists, creatives, and music industry professionals. Anzie Blue Records and Ole Smoky were among the sponsors of BMAC's 2026 gala, which took place during the album's release week and honored Black music icons Patti LaBelle, Public Enemy, and Common. https://variety.com/2026/music/news/patti-labelle-common-public-enemy-bmac-gala-2026-1236875682/

The Moonshine & Music Tour follows By Any Means: The Album artists Pynk Beard, Steve Ray Ladson, and The BoykinZ playing an acclaimed arena show at the State Fair of Texas — the nation's largest attended state fair — upon the album's release. Ladson appeared on WFAA ABC program "Good Morning Texas" to discuss By Any Means: The Album, the impact of its BMAC benefit, and Oscar buzz surrounding the title track. Watch here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zG2KG5lfCM0 The tour was then announced by Pynk Beard on WSMV NBC program "Today In Nashville." Watch here: https://youtu.be/iO0Jf5-I9BI

releases.title: Vail Turns Up the Volume, Unveils First Wave of Artists for Its Biggest Music Season Yet
releases.body:
ILLENIUM and Ian Asher kick off Vail's biggest music season yet, alongside seven on-mountain performances and two brand-new venues

VAIL, Colo., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- With the first snowfall on Vail Mountain's peaks this week and snowmaking kicked off last night, anticipation for winter is building fast. This season, Vail is raising the bar with its most ambitious music lineup yet, bringing more live music, more venues and more unforgettable performances to the mountain and village than ever before.

Headliners and New Venues

Kicking off the season on December 11, GRAMMY®-nominated, multi-platinum artist ILLENIUM will headline a marquee performance at the new Dobson Arena, ushering in a winter packed with music experiences designed for the mountains. With the potential for surprise performances throughout the weekend, fans will want to keep a close eye on social media at @VailMtn for artist announcements and unexpected moments.

On January 16, Southern California DJ, producer and remix sensation Ian Asher takes over Dobson Arena. Best known for his viral electronic and house remixes, including the billion-stream "Makeba" remix that earned Remix of the Year honors, Asher represents the next generation of dance music talent and expands Vail's growing lineup of nationally recognized artists.

Freshly transformed into a premier entertainment venue, Dobson Arena combines more than 56,000 square feet of state-of-the-art production capabilities with unmistakable alpine character, creating a concert experience unlike any other in the Rockies.

"There's nothing quite like live music in the mountains, and we're excited to bring even more of it to Vail this winter," said Shaydar Edelmann, vice president and chief operating officer of Vail Mountain. "Working alongside the Town of Vail and our community partners, we're creating more opportunities for guests to come together and enjoy incredible music in a legendary setting."

This winter builds on a breakout 2025/26 season, when Vail hosted on-mountain performances from globally recognized artists including SOFI TUKKER, Dillon Francis, Chris Lorenzo and John Summit. Always dreaming bigger, Vail is expanding its music footprint even further with seven on-mountain performances, three more than last season, plus two brand-new music venues.

Following the success of last season's first-ever sunrise concert beneath the Legendary Back Bowls sign, Vail is once again pushing the boundaries of what an alpine music experience can be. Additional artists, venues and mountain activations will be unveiled throughout the season, giving fans new reasons to visit and new ways to experience music at elevation. Announcements will be released throughout the winter on @VailMtn.

Vail Après Scene

As Vail's live music lineup grows, so does the experience surrounding it. This winter, the destination will pair headline performances and on-mountain sets with a robust lineup of après events, culinary offerings and nightlife experiences throughout the village.

  • NEW! The Vail Ice Bar: A beloved Vail tradition returns. Located next to the Legendary Back Bowls Gate, the reimagined Vail Ice Bar blends alpine nostalgia with a lively outdoor gathering space for drinks, music and après in the heart of Vail Mountain. See images of the historic Vail Ice Bar HERE.
  • Après All Day at Express Lift (base of Gondola One, starting opening day): More than 50 performing artists, nearly double last season with live DJs every Friday, Saturday and Sunday, 2:30–5:30 p.m., in collaboration with Vail Mountain partner Outer Range Brewing. See full schedule HERE. 
  • Chasing Rabbits: When the lifts stop spinning, the night is just getting started. The Rabbit Hole returns with high-energy DJ sets and unforgettable winter nights, following performances by Loud Luxury, Dombresky and Chris Lorenzo. This winter's lineup, coming soon, already includes a Coachella headliner, a Billboard Music Awards nominee and internationally recognized DJs.
  • Stoke Sessions: Live Music every Friday for the first month of the ski season in Vail. Bundle up, sip something warm, and celebrate the season with the Vail community. Lineup Announcement coming soon! Follow @discovervailcolorado to be the first to know.

Epic Passes on Sale for the 2026/27 Winter Season

Epic Passes are on sale now and with new savings for young adults, skiers and riders ages 13-30 can save 20% on an Epic Pass or Epic Local Pass. Plus, guests who purchase an Epic Pass or Epic Local Pass now will receive five Epic Friend Tickets offering 50% off adult lift tickets, making it easier to bring the crew along and save. Epic Friend Tickets can also be used for 25% off child lift ticket prices.

About Vail Mountain

Vail Mountain spans more than 5,300 acres of terrain, including the Legendary Back Bowls and Blue Sky Basin. Founded in 1962, Vail is one of the world's premier mountain destinations and a part of the Vail Resorts network connected by the Epic Pass. For more information, visit Vail.com.

releases.title: Doussan Music Group Expands with New Nashville Office and Leadership Appointments
releases.body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn. and COVINGTON, La., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Doussan Music Group (DMG Presents), an independent live entertainment and concert promotion company, is expanding its national presence with the opening of a second office in Nashville, Tennessee, and key leadership appointments.

The new office in Nashville's Wedgewood-Houston neighborhood complements the company's headquarters in Covington, Louisiana, strengthening its connections with artists, agents, venues, and industry partners nationwide.

DMG's expansion follows an extremely successful period of touring and concert promotion. In 2025 and 2026, the company promoted and produced seven college stadium dates featuring The Boys From Oklahoma package, featuring Turnpike Troubadours and Cross Canadian Ragweed, with all shows selling out or nearly selling out. DMG also co promoted Alan Jackson's final touring performance at Nashville's Nissan Stadium, capping Alan's previous two-year, 10-city arena tour. Upcoming engagements include a 16-date fall tour with platinum-selling country artist Jon Pardi and 10 November dates for Aaron Lewis's Acoustic Origins tour. Additional tours planned for 2027 are expected to be announced this fall.

To support its continued growth, DMG has strengthened its leadership team with three personnel updates:

  • Anna Margaret Kilgore joined the company as Talent Buyer in April 2026. With experience in marketing, project management, and touring promotion, she will focus on expanding DMG's event portfolio and building relationships with artists, agencies, and venues.



  • Hale Neitzschman has been named Director of Finance. He will oversee financial operations, event settlements, strategic planning, and financial processes supporting the company's growing touring schedule.



  • Rebecca Saladis has been promoted to Director of Booking, Touring, & Artist Relations. She will lead booking strategy, tour execution, and artist relations.

"Opening our Nashville office, in Wedgewood Houston, the new music hub, is a natural next step in our evolution," said Russell Doussan, President and CEO. He emphasized the company's accomplishments over the past three years and its commitment to working with talented artists to create memorable live music experiences. Founded on artist-first partnerships and exceptional live entertainment, Doussan Music Group continues to expand its concert promotion, tour production, artist relations, and venue partnerships across the country.

releases.title: Lumara Film Festival Announces Finalists for Inaugural AI Film Festival
releases.body:
Presented by MoonPay and Venice, the inaugural Lumara Film Festival festival received more than 700 submissions from filmmakers worldwide and today reveals six finalists competing for the Grand Prize and Jury Selection, with winners announced live at the World Premiere at the Roxy Hotel Cinema in New York on October 26. The evening will also feature an exclusive extended prologue of jury member and AI filmmaker Gossip Goblin's new film "Gods Don't Give Gifts.", the first-ever AI film slated for a wide theatrical release at the end of this year.

NEW YORK, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lumara Film Festival, an independent film festival for the artists defining a new era of filmmaking, presented by MoonPay and Venice, has announced the six finalists competing for its Grand Prize and Jury Selection awards and the 16 nominees for its five category awards.

Lumara was created to find and celebrate the films coming out of a transformative moment for cinema. AI has given filmmakers a new set of tools and a new creative language that opens the door to opportunities otherwise unavailable to many. Submissions were open from July 24 to September 15 and drew more than 700 films. Entry was free and open worldwide, and filmmakers could use any AI filmmaking platform available.

Films were evaluated by a jury of the world's leading AI filmmakers and internet-culture figures including Voidstomper, Gossip Goblin, Chris White (executive producer, A24's "Backrooms"), JBoogxCreative, Heavy Pulp, SÜNDERMANN, BLVCKL!GHT, Ansem and FaZe Banks. Films were judged on the strength of the idea, the quality of the storytelling, and how well the filmmaker used AI.

The six finalists will now move into competition for the Grand Prize of $32,000 and 3.2 million Venice AI credits and the Jury Selection award of $20,000 and 2 million Venice AI credits.

The finalists are:

  • "Black Thunder" (Ryan Lightbourn)
  • "Candy" (Jiaze Li)
  • "Gabriel" (T Zhang)
  • "Killabears – The Broadcast" (Mikael Tyrsen)
  • "Living with a Merman" (Chris Capel)
  • "Mianmian" (Yingjie Chen)

This year's categories and their nominees include:

  • Terminal Award (best experimental film), $12,000 and 1.2 million Venice AI credits
    • "REVIVER" (Aleksey Dor)
    • "Stories My Great Great Great Grandmother Told Me" (Philippe Noguchi)
    • "THE LAST TRIBE" (Stephane Benini)
  • Serenissima Award (best film made with Venice), $12,000 and 1.2 million Venice AI credits
    • "Black Thunder" (Ryan Lightbourn)
    • "Er Loop" (Marco Magario)
    • "Never Forget" (Allan Ecax)
  • Get Shorty Award (best film under two minutes), $8,000 and 800,000 Venice AI credits
    • "Ato de [Later]" (Luke Mazey)
    • "COMPULSION" (Gyuseon Lee)
    • "Do Not Disturb" (Adrian Daniel Botnariu)
    • "Summer Afternoon, July 1994" (Charlie Park)
  • Mouse Award (best film for children or young adults), $8,000 and 800,000 Venice AI credits
    • "Far away home" (Siping Song)
    • "FIX" (Eunha Lee, Sora Lee and Hakhoon Lee)
    • "Roraima" (Ishan Devare Modi)
  • Rekt Award (best satire, comedy or musical about finance, markets or crypto), $8,000 and 800,000 Venice AI credits
    • "Great Pepe Wars" (Aiden Guo)
    • "JUST SAY SOLANA" (Yassine Le Gall)
    • "ROLL EVERYTHING" (Ashanth Phillips)

The winner of each category award will be announced on the Venice and MoonPay channels.

The finalists will be screened in full at the inaugural Lumara screening and awards night taking place on October 26 at the Roxy Hotel Cinema in New York City, with winners announced at the event.

releases.title: TRAILER PARK PAM Announces Album Release Following Brief, 25-Year Strategic Pause
releases.body:
LOS ANGELES, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Recorded in 2001. Held back for the good of rock 'n' roll. TRAILER PARK PAM has arrived.

As Universal Music Entertainment debuts the self-titled original album today, the band is finally ready to reveal its bold strategy: wait 25 years for rock 'n' roll to be declared dead, then unveil an album recorded when it was still breathing.

The band — Keith Megna on vocals, his brother David Megna on bass, Hans Hettich on lead guitar, and Chuck Sparks on drums — spent the last quarter century allowing the world to catch up.

"We could see where things were headed in 2001," said lead singer Keith Megna. "We figured we'd let the entire music industry change, collapse, rebuild itself, and then see if Friday was a good day to release it."

"The time is now," said David Megna. "Some bands are ahead of their time. We wanted documentation."

Former manager John Asher confirmed that the delay was absolutely intentional.

"A lot of people would call this an unreleased album," said Asher. "We prefer an extremely exclusive listening period."

This time capsule recording, produced by Jerry Harrison of Talking Heads, will make you want to call your Mom after listening to the heartfelt "Photo Memories." Break out an old Hendrix vinyl after exorcising the ghosts of "Falling Stars."  Or smash your TV by the time "Talk Circus" reaches its final chord. 

Now, after surviving the death of the CD, the rise of streaming, and several generations of people explaining that rock is dead, TRAILER PARK PAM is ready to be unearthed.

The wait is over.

Out October 16, 2026 on all streaming platforms.

NEW YORK, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ¡HOLA! Americas announces the musical lineup for the Latina Powerhouse 100 Gala, taking place on November 2 at the Ziff Ballet Opera House at the Adrienne Arsht Center in Miami. The evening will feature a spectacular live production led by the Latina Powerhouse Big Band, bringing together established artists and rising talent for a tribute to the musical traditions and influences that have enriched the culture of the Americas.

The lineup will feature Natalia Jiménez, Camila Fernández, María José, Erika Ender, Aymée Nuviola, Leslie Grace, and Ela Taubert, representing a remarkable range of musical styles, generations, and cultural backgrounds.

Held under the theme "The Hispanic Legacy: Inspiring America's Future," the gala will present "The Soundtrack of the Americas," a musical journey through the genres, rhythms, and influences that have shaped the cultural identity of the Americas.

The performance will feature the Latina Powerhouse Big Band, under the musical direction of Dr. Colleen Clark, a jazz drummer, composer, professor at the University of South Carolina, and founder of Jazz Girls Day®, a national program encouraging girls and young women to pursue jazz.

Serving as associate director will be Dr. Matt White, a trumpeter, composer, Guggenheim Fellow, and Director of Jazz Studies at the University of South Carolina. Together, they will lead a musical production featuring original arrangements created especially for the occasion.

The evening will also feature special guest performances by Nella, Luis Enrique, Joaquina, MŌRIAH, Siudy Garrido, Nicole Zuraitis, and Irany.

"We are proud to bring together such remarkable artists for this celebration. Music has always been part of our history, and so many of the songs we love have become part of our lives. With The Soundtrack of the Americas, we want to honor that musical legacy and the artists who continue to shape it. Above all, Latina Powerhouse 100 is about celebrating extraordinary women whose achievements have opened doors for others and whose stories deserve to be told," said Nagidmy Márquez Acosta, Chief Content Officer of ¡HOLA! Americas.

LATINA POWERHOUSE 100

Now in its second edition, the gala will recognize the leadership, achievements, and contributions of Hispanic women across the United States and Latin America. The program will include the annual selection of 100 outstanding women, along with special honors recognizing exceptional careers and accomplishments across different industries.

The full list of the 100 Latina Powerhouse 2026 honorees will be announced in October 2026.

¡HOLA! Americas is the leading entertainment and lifestyle platform for Hispanic audiences in the United States and Latin America. Through its editorial coverage, ¡HOLA! brings readers closer to the people and stories shaping entertainment, culture, fashion, and contemporary life.

¡HOLA! USA launched in New York in 2016 with a bilingual digital edition in English and Spanish. As the brand grew beyond the U.S., ¡HOLA! USA became ¡HOLA! Americas, reflecting its growing presence throughout the region.

In October 2024, ¡HOLA! celebrated its 80th anniversary by lighting the Empire State Building in its iconic red, marking eight decades since its founding in 1944.

¡HOLA! Americas is part of ¡HOLA! & HELLO! Media Group, an international media group present in 18 countries, with 15 print editions and 14 websites in eight languages. The group also operates a television channel serving Hispanic audiences in the United States and Latin America.

releases.title: STACY POLLEY'S ACT VI FOR THE FORK IT FUND BROUGHT MUSIC, COMMUNITY AND PURPOSE TO SONY HALL IN SUPPORT OF ALZHEIMER'S PREVENTION RESEARCH
releases.body:
NEW YORK, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Fork It Fund, a program dedicated to advancing transformational research focused on the prevention of Alzheimer's disease and all other dementias, brought together supporters, caregivers and friends for Act VI, an evening of music, performance and philanthropy on Thursday, October 8 at Sony Hall in New York City.

The evening raised over $1.2 million for prevention-focused research while recognizing the caregivers and families touched by the disease. Founded in 2019 by Stacy Polley and Daryl and Irwin Simon, the Fork It Fund has raised more than $5 million for research in partnership with the Alzheimer's Association, the world's leading nonprofit funder of Alzheimer's research.

For Polley, a former Goldman Sachs Partner, Act VI held special meaning. Her acclaimed "Acts" began as a creative passion, rooted in the love of music and theater her father, a musician, nurtured in her from an early age and carried with her throughout her life. As his Alzheimer's progressed, that passion grew into a mission to fund the research that could spare other families the same experience. Following his passing this past summer, this year's performance became a tribute to the man who first taught her the joy of the stage.

"My Acts began as something creative and joyful, but as my father's Alzheimer's progressed, they came to mean so much more to me," said Polley. "Act VI was a chance to honor my father, celebrate caregivers like my mother who give so much, and bring people together around a disease that has touched so many families. My hope is that the joy we created together will help fund the science that changes the story for future generations."

The Fork It Fund's mission is rooted in the belief that prevention research and early detection are essential. The Fund supports research working to understand how Alzheimer's can be detected and addressed early, while building a community that raises awareness of steps people can take to support their brain health and lower their risk.

Act VI carried that mission forward, bringing guests together for an evening of connection and remembrance, united by the belief that scientific progress and human connection can change what is possible.

releases.title: Plex and Fandango Turn Movie Discovery Into Theatrical Ticket Sales
releases.body:
New integration creates a direct path from discovery to purchase, giving studios and advertisers a new

way to reach high-intent moviegoers

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Plex, the global streaming platform for discovering, watching and connecting around entertainment, and Fandango, the nation's leading online movie ticketer, today announced an integration that creates a direct path from movie discovery to theatrical ticketing by allowing users to purchase tickets as they explore films on Plex. For studios, distributors and advertisers, the collaboration creates a new way to drive ticket sales at the point of discovery.

Starting today, Plex users in the U.S. will see a Fandango ticketing option on title pages for movies currently playing in theaters, allowing them to click through to Fandango to find showtimes and purchase tickets. The integration also enables direct attribution through Kochava, giving studios and advertisers greater visibility into how campaigns and audience engagement translate into ticket sales.

Plex users make more than 100 million streaming decisions each month, with more than 45 million users creating watchlists. Combined with search, ratings and cross-platform viewing, these signals give Plex insight into audience intent, while Fandango's reach across 31,000 U.S. screens provides a direct path from discovery to ticket purchase

"Our vision is to make Plex the place where people can discover what to watch, regardless of where that content lives. Fandango lets us extend that experience to all theatrical releases in the U.S., giving fans an easy way to act once they find a movie they want to see," Scott Olechowski, Chief Product Officer and Co-Founder at Plex. "For studios and advertisers, we're also creating a more measurable path from discovery to purchase, helping marketers understand which campaigns are converting, so they can use those insights to make their media work harder."

"Plex has a unique view into what movie fans are actively considering, from what they're searching for to what they're watching across services," said Jerramy Hainline, EVP, Fandango. "By connecting those discovery signals with Fandango ticketing, we're making it easier for fans to turn that interest into a trip to the theater, while giving studios and advertisers a more direct, measurable path to ticket sales."

Fans can purchase tickets on Fandango now via watch.plex.tv. Visuals available here.

About Plex

Plex is the social entertainment app made for movie and TV lovers, available in more than 180 countries and territories. It brings discovery, community, and free streaming together in one place, making it easier to enjoy everything entertainment has to offer. Discover what's streaming across platforms and playing in theaters, see what friends are watching, swap recommendations, and keep track of everything on your watchlist. Plus, stream thousands of free movies and shows, watch hundreds of free live TV channels, rent premium new releases, and organize and stream your own personal media collection.

Plex. Your watch starts here. For more, visit watch.plex.tv or follow @plex.tv on X, Facebook and Instagram.

About Fandango 

Fandango is the premier digital destination for movie and TV fans, delivering entertainment experiences across discovery, ticketing, reviews, and at-home streaming. Serving more than 50 million unique visitors monthly, Fandango is the leading online movie ticketer across more than 31,000 U.S. movie screens, operates Rotten Tomatoes, the world's leading entertainment review platform, and offers a premium video-on-demand service featuring more than 300,000 new-release and catalog movies and TV shows, including one of the industry's largest selections of 4K UHD titles. The portfolio also includes Fandango1, which provides exhibitors with a modern, cloud-based cinema operating platform that powers ticketing, concessions, loyalty, payments and more for cinema locations worldwide and Fandango FanClub, which gives fans access to exclusive perks and rewards. Fandango helps fans discover, watch, collect, and enjoy entertainment wherever and whenever they choose.

releases.title: Cineverse and Trevor Henderson to Adapt Hit Horror Podcast 'Mayfair Watchers Society' into a Feature Film
releases.body:
From the Mind Behind Siren Head and Cartoon Cat, and one of the Hottest Indie Creators, with Recent Studio Deals with Warner Bros. and TriStar

Feature Film Comes as Season 4 of the Scripted Audio Series Set to Launch on the Cineverse Podcast Network

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, has made a deal with Trevor Henderson, creator of Siren Head and Cartoon Cat, to adapt the hit horror podcast Mayfair Watchers Society into a feature film. Downloaded more than three million times since premiering on audio on October 10, 2022, the Mayfair Watchers Society story will continue both on the big screen and through the podcast, which premieres its fourth season soon with the Cineverse Podcast Network.

This agreement comes at a time during which Hollywood demand for Henderson's viral online creations has exploded. Earlier this year, Warner Bros. Pictures won a bidding war to turn Henderson's Siren Head character into a movie, with Zach Cregger and Brian Duffield attached. Another of his popular and terrifying characters, Cartoon Cat, is being adapted into a film by Sony's TriStar Pictures, with Roy Lee producing. 

"It has truly been the year that online creators have planted their flag as the new generation of horror filmmakers and characters. This deal to expand our relationship with Trevor, and adapt this podcast into a feature with him, presents a great opportunity for us, him, and his fans, and we can't wait," said Cineverse Chief Motion Pictures Officer Yolanda Macias.

Since successfully bringing Terrifier 2 and Terrifier 3 to theatres, the Cineverse Motion Pictures Group has shown a commitment to supporting filmmakers with unique creative visions and IP with loyal, passionate fanbases. This includes the 20th anniversary release of Guillermo del Toro's masterpiece, Pan's Labyrinth, which opened in theatres October 8.

"There hasn't been a box office movement in years as transformational as the success seen by online creators with Iron Lung, Backrooms, and Obsession. We're incredibly fortunate to be in a position where we can use our platforms to work with independent artists and bring their visions to life reaching audiences in entirely new ways. Mayfair Watchers Society has been an incredible collaboration with Trevor, and I can't wait to continue that partnership and bring Mayfair to the big screen," said Cineverse VP Network Strategy and Co-founder, Bloody Disgusting, Tom Owen.

The feature will be a found footage style anthology film highlighting different creatures and stories from the podcast. These include The Needle, Creekman, Owls with Teeth, Mr. Bag, Anxious Dogs, Scissors, and The Clatter.

"The Cineverse and Bloody Disgusting teams have been great partners on the podcast, and I've long been impressed with the film side of the company, and its indie philosophy. I look forward to being very hands-on with adapting the podcast into a feature, and look forward to working closely with them as we develop the film, select the directing and writing teams, and get closer to bringing this to fans," said Henderson, who will be a producer and part of the writing team.

The Mayfair Watchers Society podcast is an original production of Bloody FM, Cineverse Podcast Network's horror brand. Created by Henderson and Pacific Obadiah, and produced by Obadiah, Mayfair Watchers Society is presented as a collection of found tapes and audio accounts, each episode focusing on different residents encountering Henderson's iconic style of monsters. It was chosen by Apple as one of the most popular podcasts when it debuted in 2022, and has been a top 50 podcast and the #2-ranked fiction podcast on both Apple and Spotify.

Trevor Henderson is represented by Verve, Redshift, and Marios Rush. The deal was negotiated by Macias and Cineverse VP Creative Development and Filmmaker Relations Steven Peros.

About Cineverse Motion Pictures Group

Cineverse super-serves passionate audiences by distributing content across all windows and platforms, from theatrical to digital to physical. Following the breakout box office success of Terrifier 3, recent theatrical releases include the franchise returns of The Toxic Avenger, Silent Night, Deadly Night, and Return to Silent Hill, and the 20th anniversary release of Guillermo del Toro's masterpiece Pan's Labyrinth. On Cineverse's upcoming slate are the third installment of Wolf Creek and the company's first theatrical family feature, Air Bud Returns.

About Cineverse

Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS) is an entertainment technology company and studio. Fiercely innovative and independent, Cineverse develops and invests in technology and content that drives the future of the industry. Core to its business is Matchpoint® – a growing tech ecosystem designed to prepare, distribute, monetize, and continuously improve content across any platform. Matchpoint helps studios large and small operate at scale and improve performance and efficiency in an increasingly fragmented distribution environment. Additionally, Cineverse distributes a vast library of premium films, series, and podcasts, across theatrical, home entertainment, and streaming; operates dozens of digital properties that super serve passionate fandoms around the world; and works with leading brands to connect them with audiences they value. From award-winning technology to the highest-grossing unrated film in U.S. history, Cineverse has created a playbook that marries tech and content to redefine the next era of entertainment. releases.title: Great American Media Invests in Wholesome, Family Streaming Entertainment for Latinos with Launch of Pure Flix Familia
releases.body:
• New streaming destination launches in time for Hispanic Heritage Month and peak holiday season with Spanish-language programming and a long-term strategy spanning Spanish, English, and Bilingual storytelling
  • Debut programming includes original microdrama Alquilé Un Novio Para Navidad and a national call for Latino-produced family and faith films

NEW YORK, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Great American Media is expanding its investment in Latino audiences with today's launch of Pure Flix Familia, a new streaming destination created for families seeking culturally relevant entertainment rooted in faith, family and shared values.

Pure Flix Familia launches in Spanish, with bilingual and English stories for Latino audiences to follow.

Launching during Hispanic Heritage Month and at the start of the Christmas family-viewing season, Pure Flix Familia will debut with Spanish-language entertainment that will continuously grow to include English-language, and bilingual storytelling created and curated for Latino audiences.

"Great American Pure Flix is the leading faith-and-family streaming service, and Pure Flix Familia will build on that foundation with programming and experiences created specifically for Latino families," said Bill Abbott, President and CEO of Great American Media. "Faith and family are at the heart of Great American Media, and those values have deep roots within the Latino community. We are committed to working with talented Latino creators to tell authentic, compelling stories and to building a trusted entertainment destination for families in the United States and around the world."

Pure Flix Familia represents the next step in Great American Media's continued growth, extending the company's faith-and-family mission to a new audience while complementing the programming available on Great American Pure Flix. First announced in December 2025, Pure Flix Familia is being developed around a Total Latino Market strategy that recognizes how today's Latino audiences move across languages, cultures, countries and generations. Rather than defining viewers solely by language preference, the platform will serve a broad spectrum of the Latino experience, connected by culture, family and shared values.

The market opportunity is significant. According to Nielsen's 2025 Diverse Intelligence Series report, U.S. Hispanics represent more than $4.1 trillion in purchasing power, while streaming accounts for 55.8% of their total television viewing time, compared with 46% for the overall U.S. population.

At launch, Pure Flix Familia will offer original, licensed and Spanish-dubbed movies, series, family entertainment, and faith-centered storytelling. Programming will reflect the humor, romance, faith, traditions, family relationships, and multigenerational experiences that are part of Latino life.

Great American Media is working with Minivela, the Latino media, entertainment, and production company co-founded by media entrepreneur Manny Ruiz and actor-producer Carlos Ponce, as the programming, content and creative partner for Pure Flix Familia. Ruiz and Ponce bring decades of experience working within the Latino community and across Hispanic media and entertainment.

"We approached Pure Flix because we saw an opportunity for more wholesome entertainment created with Latino families in mind, and they immediately understood the need," Ponce said. "Families shouldn't have to choose between stories that authentically reflect their culture and entertainment they feel good about bringing into their homes. Pure Flix Familia brings those two things together."

The debut slate will feature Pure Flix Familia's first original microdrama, Alquilé Un Novio Para Navidad, produced by Pure Flix Familia in association with Minivela. The faith-based microdrama follows a woman who enlists the perfect boyfriend to keep her family's Noche Buena gathering questions at bay—only to discover that real feelings weren't part of the deal. A little holiday pretending turns into a lot of romantic chaos in this heartwarming Christmas romcom.

In partnership with Chicano Hollywood, and a coalition of Latino film festival leaders, Pure Flix Familia will also support Latino storytellers through a national call for Latino-produced feature films and short films centered on family and/or faith. Selected projects will be considered for licensing or acquisition, creating a new pathway for filmmakers and independent producers seeking a home for culturally authentic, values-driven storytelling. Submission criteria and deadlines will be announced separately.

The October launch also brings Pure Flix Familia to audiences as the Christmas viewing season begins, building on one of Great American Media and Pure Flix's signature programming strengths. Great American Pure Flix offers an extensive collection of Christmas movies and series, giving Pure Flix Familia a strong foundation for serving families during one of the most family-centered times of the year.

The U.S. debut represents the first step in Great American Media's longer-term vision for Pure Flix Familia, with the company ultimately looking to serve audiences throughout Latin America and Spain and build a global Latino and Spanish-language faith and family entertainment brand.

Additional announcements regarding Pure Flix Familia's complete launch slate, subscription options, supported devices and availability will be made in the coming weeks.

ABOUT GREAT AMERICAN MEDIA

Great American Media is the leader in faith and family entertainment, and one of the fastest-growing entertainment networks on television. Great American Media is home to a portfolio of entertainment brands that celebrate faith, family, and country, including Great American Family, the flagship linear network featuring original Christmas movies, rom-coms, and beloved series; Great American Pure Flix, the leading faith and family streaming service; Great American Faith & Living, the unscripted companion network; and GFam+, an app that lets viewers watch anytime, anywhere. Great American Media, established in June 2021 by Bill Abbott and a group of US-based family offices, is available via cable, streaming on Pure Flix and YouTube TV, and on the GFam+ app.

releases.title: Human Diamonds: A New Blueprint for AI Companies to Prove Their Value to Humanity
releases.body:
Event Horizon Film Studio LLC announces Scott Hadley Morgan's vision for combining AI, entertainment, and human connection in a new digital ecosystem.

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Can AI companies compete to become the best for humanity while still winning the race to dominate their markets? In his book Human Diamonds, writer, producer, and director Scott Hadley Morgan explores a different way to approach that challenge.

Morgan began developing his ideas in 2018, building a framework that starts with physics and expands into astrophysics, biology, geology, and chemistry. His conclusion is that AI needs an environment where its impact can be explored through real human engagement. His proposed answer is the Multiverse, an entertainment, shopping, and social platform designed to bring AI companies and people together.

AI Gems: Where Loyalty Becomes Valuable

Morgan calls participating individuals and groups "AI Gems" because he believes their loyalty and engagement could become precious to AI companies, much like diamonds. Individuals could build their own presence, while communities, student organizations, and other groups could form Gem Teams and earn rewards.

"Let's say Anthropic offers to pay student debt for a fraternity if it uses only their AI in this Multiverse," Morgan explains. He envisions additional activities, such as debate teams, creating opportunities for further rewards and real-world benefits.

Morgan sees this as a new way for AI companies to build loyalty by giving people tangible reasons to participate. He compares the opportunity to the early growth of Google, when user participation helped establish its dominance in search.

Imagii: An Avatar Built Around You

Another key element is the Imagii, a personalized avatar Morgan designed around 49 apps intended to reflect different aspects of an individual's identity, interests, and aspirations. The concept begins with epigenetics, moves through technology, and extends toward personal and spiritual goals.

Morgan imagines that an AI Gem could explain a specific dream and find other Gems who have had the same dream. Combined with fantasy leagues, influencers, and interactive communities, he envisions an experience that feels like "Limitless meets Avatar."

Hollywood Meets the Future of AI

Morgan brings an award-winning career as a Hollywood writer, producer, and director to his vision. He believes storytelling has always helped humanity imagine what is possible, and that entertainment could play an essential role in making AI more engaging and beneficial to people.

Through Event Horizon Film Studio LLC, Morgan connects his entertainment background with his broader ideas about technology, creativity, and human potential.

"The power of story has uplifted humanity since our origin," Morgan says.

With Human Diamonds, Morgan invites AI professionals, investors, entertainment leaders, and anyone concerned about AI's future to explore a blueprint that puts human participation, creativity, family, and connection at the center of technological progress.

Morgan also welcomes inquiries from AI companies interested in consulting opportunities to explore how the Multiverse concept and the ideas presented in Human Diamonds could be developed to their fullest potential.

Read an excerpt from Human Diamonds and explore Morgan's video presentations at https://www.eventhorizon.studio.

For consulting inquiries, contact Scott Hadley Morgan through Event Horizon Film Studio LLC via the website.

releases.title: Korean Cultural Center New York Presents the 1st New York Korean Independent Film Festival (NYKIFF)
releases.body:
October 15–25, 2026: Exploring the Present and Future of Korean Independent Cinema

Featuring 10 Feature Films and 5 Shorts in Collaboration with Leading Korean Film Festivals

12 Directors and Film Professionals to Visit New York for Audience Q&As

NEW YORK, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Korean Cultural Center New York (KCCNY) presents the inaugural New York Korean Independent Film Festival (NYKIFF) from October 15 through 25, 2026, at the KCCNY Theater. The festival seeks to expand international screening opportunities for outstanding Korean independent films and foster meaningful exchange between Korean filmmakers and New York's film community.

Korea's independent film community produces outstanding works with the potential to resonate internationally, yet limited exhibition and distribution opportunities have kept many from reaching audiences abroad. The inaugural festival responds to this gap by providing a platform for these films in New York, bringing greater visibility to Korean independent cinema and creating opportunities for its filmmakers to gain recognition on the international stage.

Featuring 10 feature films and 5 shorts, the festival brings together a wide range of cinematic voices through a program developed in collaboration with leading Korean film festivals. 12 directors and other film professionals will visit New York to meet audiences through post-screening Q&As.

The lineup was developed in collaboration with the Seoul Independent Film Festival, Jeonju International Film Festival, Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival, Muju Film Festival, and Mise-en-scène Short Film Festival in Korea. Spanning fiction, documentary, thriller, and action, the 15-film selection introduces New York audiences to the distinctive perspectives shaping Korean independent cinema today.

Admission is free and open to the public, but pre-registration is required.

Opening and Closing Films

The festival opens with STARS AND SAND, directed by KAM JEONGWON, winner of the Grand Prize at the 51st Seoul Independent Film Festival. KAM JEONGWON and cinematographer CHOI CHANG HWAN will attend the opening screening and participate in a post-screening Q&A. A networking reception will follow, providing an opportunity for exchange with members of the local film community.

The festival closes with THE WORLD OF LOVE, directed by YOON GA-EUN, who received the Best Director award in the film category at the 62nd Baeksang Arts Awards.

Feature Film Highlights

Director LEE WEONYOUNG will visit New York to present THE GLIMMERING, which received the Grand Prize at the Muju Film Festival, while director KIM MYUNWOO will join audiences for KARMA, an award-winning selection from the Jeonju International Film Festival. Both filmmakers will participate in post-screening Q&As.

Additional feature selections include THE ONLY CHILD IN THE BUTCHERY, SAVON, THE FIN, THE LOVE OF TRUMAN, REI'S WINTER BREAK, and THE GORALS, bringing a range of distinctive stories and cinematic approaches to New York audiences.

Mise-en-scène Shorts: Award-Winning Films and Visiting Filmmakers

Co-presented with Korea Creative Content Agency New York (KOCCANY) and Netflix Korea, the special Mise-en-scène Short Film Festival section showcases five award-winning films from the festival's 22nd edition: MY AUNT, WRONG AIM, MIXEDUP SHAMAN, NOISE CANCELLATION, and AFTER SUBMERSION.

Directors WI EUNG-KYOUNG, SON GWANG-MIN, KIM KEUNHO, CHOI JIHYE, and PARK JEONG-SU will attend to meet audiences, joined by JANG YOUNG-YEOP, ceo of Cine21, a leading Korean film magazine.

"Viki Pass It On" celebrates the passionate fans powering Asian entertainment's skyrocketing global popularity with a video spot running on CTV as well as major social and digital channels. In addition, LE SSERAFIM has curated a watch list for Viki subscribers of the group members' favorite Asian series.

Created in partnership with creative agency UNFOLD, "Viki Pass It On" launches today in the U.S. and other key global markets. Watch the spot here.

The campaign launches as Viki's audience approaches 130 million registered users and follows the recent premiere of Viki's original K-drama co-production Dive into You. Next up is the debut of another co-production, The Painted Soul, a Korean animated series coming to Viki on October 21.

The ad spot celebrates fans' passion for Asian entertainment. As LE SSERAFIM prepares to take the stage, the group passes around a mobile device, with each member spotlighting a favorite Viki show that reflects her personality – from addictive K-dramas and swoon-worthy C-dramas to variety shows. Each handoff captures the essence of how fan culture spreads: the thrill of discovering something you love and sharing it with your friends.

"Asian entertainment, from K-pop to Korean and Chinese dramas, has found a passionate global audience because of the extraordinary talent behind it, the compelling stories, and the fans who share it with each other," said Karen Paek, vice president of Marketing at Viki. "This campaign is a tribute to those fans, and we're proud to celebrate them alongside LE SSERAFIM."

LE SSERAFIM is a K-pop group formed in 2022 whose members include KIM CHAEWON, SAKURA, HUH YUNJIN, KAZUHA, and HONG EUNCHAE. They recently kicked off the '2026 LE SSERAFIM TOUR 'PUREFLOW,'' spanning Korea, Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. LE SSERAFIM recently released the single album Made My Night, which was followed with appearances and live events including a headline performance at BlizzCon® 2026 and at the iHeartRadio Music Festival, becoming the first K-pop girl group to take the festival stage.

Viki is available to watch for free (with advertisements) or without advertisements through tiered subscriptions of Viki Pass Standard and Viki Pass Plus, and is available on web and several platforms via desktop, mobile, streaming devices, and connected TVs.

Rakuten Viki is a leading global destination for Asian entertainment, attracting audiences worldwide with an extensive library of dramas, variety shows, movies, and Viki Originals from across Asia. LE SSERAFIM, consisting of KIM CHAEWON, SAKURA, HUH YUNJIN, KAZUHA, and HONG EUNCHAE, are the first girl group formed by SOURCE MUSIC under HYBE. releases.title: Buldak Celebrates Guinness World Records® Achievement with Original Song and Music Video "Crave the Burn"
releases.body:
Available Now Across Buldak's Official YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Channels

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Buldak is turning its Guinness World Records® achievement into a soundtrack with the release of "Crave the Burn," an original song and music video celebrating the fans who came together to make history by uploading the most videos of people eating instant noodles to TikTok in one hour. Watch the music video on Buldak's YouTube channel. 

Blending pop energy with Latin flavor and a golden vibe, Buldak's "Crave the Burn" features English and Spanish lyrics that celebrate the brand's bold spirit and the fans who made the world record possible. 

Directed by Weston Allen, the music video features choreography by Brian Esperon, as well as clips from the record-breaking attempt. The song and music video come on the heels of Buldak fans making history on October 1, when 335 qualifying videos were uploaded to TikTok in a single hour as part of the brand's Guinness World Records attempt. The total surpassed the previous record of 250 videos by 85, an increase of 34%.

For Buldak, the song is a celebration not just of the record, but of the people behind it. "'Crave the Burn' and its music video are a way to celebrate our fans, who have played such an important role in making Buldak what it is today and will continue to shape our future," said Abbas Arslan, the Vice President of Marketing at Buldak. "We're incredibly grateful to everyone who enjoys our noodles and helped make this achievement possible."

Since launching in 2012, Buldak has inspired spicy challenges, reaction videos, recipes and countless fan creations across social platforms, connecting fans through a shared love of flavor, heat and pushing their limits.

Fans can watch the "Crave the Burn" music video and follow Buldak's latest content on YouTube, TikTok and Instagram at @buldak_global.

ABOUT BULDAK

Buldak was born from a spicy chicken dish and a simple idea: what if that bold, fiery flavor could become a ramyeon? Rooted in Samyang's rich Korean heritage and launched in Korea in 2012, Buldak quickly became a spicy cult favorite, winning over fans around the world with its intense heat and unmistakable flavor. Today, Buldak has grown into a global cultural phenomenon and a favorite among Gen Z and Gen Alpha, bringing together the signature flavors of OG and Carbonara with playful energy and self-expression. As Korean food and culture continue to influence global trends, Buldak continues to push the boundaries of instant noodles, creating new flavors, experiences, and ways for fans to enjoy the brand. Buldak is part of the portfolio of brands from Samyang Foods, headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Visit Buldak.com to learn more.

releases.body:
IRVINE, Calif., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bandai Namco Filmworks Inc. brought MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM to New York audiences on Sunday, October 11 and Monday, October 12 with a two-day screening event at the Museum of the Moving Image (MoMI) in Queens. Kaori Shida, Planning Producer of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM and MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO, joined the October 11 program for a live talk, speaking to an audience of fans and members of the press about the GUNDAM SEED series and the upcoming film, which arrives in North American theaters in February 2027.

Assets are available here.

The October 11 program, GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM Screening & Talk Show at the Museum of the Moving Image, opened at 6:30 PM with a talk show hosted by MC Mike Nishimura. Members of the press were in attendance alongside fans who traveled to the Museum for the evening.

Shida joined SUNRISE inc. (Current Bandai Namco Filmworks INC.) in 2001 and worked in setting production on MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED DESTINY before serving as Planning Producer on titles including Gundam Build Fighters and MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM, and was also involved in the stage play adaptation of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM 00 as well as GUNDAM FACTORY YOKOHAMA, the project built around the moving life-size Gundam in Yokohama.

During the talk show, Shida looked back on the journey of the series from DESTINY to FREEDOM, explaining how production materials for the anime, including mobile suit designs, are developed. She also shared how MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM came to life nearly twenty years after DESTINY. 

The program then turned to the newest chapter in the series. The teaser trailer for MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO, first unveiled days earlier at New York Comic Con, screened for the room, and Shida pointed audiences toward what the film sets out to show: how the world changed in the years between DESTINY and FREEDOM, what each character lived through in that span, and the mobile suit battle sequences the production has put particular effort into.

"We were able to take advantage of many new technologies developed over the past two decades to create exciting and dynamic mobile suit action. I hope fans will pay close attention to how these new animation techniques have been brought to life in this film."

The talk show was followed at 7:00 PM by a screening of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM in Japanese with English subtitles. The event continued on Monday, October 12 with a 4:00 PM screening of the film.

Closing the talk, Shida shared a message with the fans in the United States who have followed the SEED series and the Gundam series over the past two decades, saying:

"Without the Gundam fans, we might not have been able to see FREEDOM ZERO become an actual anime. This has become a reality because FREEDOM was loved by fans."

MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM ZERO arrives in theaters across North America in February 2027.
