Plus: Top Cineverse FAST Channels including The Dog Whisperer and The Bob Ross Channel Now Available on Fire TV Devices

LOS ANGELES, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, has announced the launch of eight video podcasts on Amazon Fire TV. This marks the company's first major distribution of ad-supported video-on-demand (AVOD) podcasts (VODcasts), furthering its commitment to growing the Cineverse Podcast Network – including horror shows from Bloody FM and comedy from the WITZ Podcast Network.

Additionally, some of Cineverse's most popular free, ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels are also available via Fire TV.

Shows now available to all Amazon Fire TV customers – with no download, sign-ups, or fees – include:

  • Bad Movies Rule! – A comedy podcast for people who love so-called bad movies - those that have been declared bad by critics or audiences to see if they really deserve to be on the trash pile or if they actually rule.
  • Mohr Stories with Jay Mohr – hosted by comedian/actor and SNL alum Jay Mohr, featuring candid, often humorous interviews with celebrities, comics, and cultural figures. Discussions span careers, personal stories, and life in Hollywood, sometimes including in-depth, emotional, or nostalgic conversations.
  • The Stand Comedy Club Presents: 10 for 10 – 10 for 10 is The Stand Comedy Club's signature series celebrating a decade (and counting) of the club's raw, transformative impact on stand-up comedy. Hosted by the sharp and seasoned Kieran McCann, each episode dives deep with a standout comedian who calls The Stand home- unpacking the grind, the bombs, the breakthroughs, the green-room chaos, and the nights that changed everything. Past guests include Jim Gaffigan, Shane Gillis, Ari Shaffir, Janeane Garofalo, T.J. Miller and more!

"The trend toward video podcasts is well documented, with every major platform getting into the game, and Fire TV is the latest sign of our commitment to reaching audiences where and how they want to consume," said Tom Owen, Vice President, Networks Strategy. "According to Sounds Profitable, 71% of podcast creators are producing video, and revenue for video podcasts is estimated to be 12x higher per year than for audio-only. We are embracing this reality and will continue to do so moving forward."

Additionally, customers can now instantly access these Cineverse FAST channels for free on Fire TV:

  • The Bob Ross Channel – home to more than 400 episodes of The Joy of Painting.
  • Dog Whisperer with Cesar Millan – featuring all nine seasons and 160 episodes of the popular series.
  • GoPro Channel – features exhilarating, first-person action sports content from across the globe.
  • HISTORIAN – a variety of history-based programming, in partnership with American Public Television, where viewers can watch history unfold.
  • JoySauce TV – dedicated to American Asian audiences.
  • Real Madrid TV – comprehensive behind-the-scenes access to one of the world's most successful soccer clubs, delivering match highlights, exclusive interviews and documentaries.
  • Yu-Gi-Oh! – features nearly 400 hours of episodes spanning iconic titles like Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters, Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS, and the movie Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions.

"We're thrilled to also be adding these FAST channels for Amazon Fire TV customers," added Cineverse Vice President of Partnerships Alexandra Viglione. "From established leaders in Dog Whisperer and Bob Ross, to new channels like HISTORIAN and JoySauce, fans of any IP or genre can find something they enjoy through Fire TV devices."

About Cineverse Podcast Network

Cineverse operates a top-10 podcast network with more than 35 audio series. It leverages owned-and-operated brands like Bloody Disgusting, Midnight Pulp and RetroCrush to deliver hit shows in horror, true crime and entertainment, also recently expanding into comedy programming with the launch of WITZ Podcast Network in partnership with The Stand Group. A growing division of the Company, the Cineverse Podcast Network generates advertising revenue from brands across key categories, including movie studios, retailers and consumer products. Series include Mayfair Watchers Society (from the mind of Siren Head creator Trevor Henderson), The Bloody Disgusting Podcast (hosted by Zena Dixon and Shelby Novak), Creepy Places (a true crime podcast hosted by Jon Grilz), The Dead (in partnership with The George A. Romero Foundation), The Losers Club (breaking down Stephen King's career chronologically), Murder in America (co-hosted by Courtney Shannon & Colin Browen), and more.

About Cineverse Streaming

Cineverse owns and/or operates a wide range of premium streaming brands, from free, ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels to subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) apps. These span fandoms – from single IP channels around pop cultural icons such as Bob Ross and The Dog Whisperer with Cesar Milan, to channels curated for fans of Horror (Screambox, Midnight Pulp), Anime and Pan-Asian shows and films (RetroCrush, AsianCrush), Comedy (Gorilla Comedy+), Independent Film (Fandor), Romance (Dove Channel) and True Crime (Crime Hunters), to name a few.

About Cineverse

Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS) is an entertainment technology company and studio. Fiercely innovative and independent, Cineverse develops and invests in technology and content that drives the future of the industry. Core to its business is Matchpoint® – a growing tech ecosystem designed to prepare, distribute, monetize, and continuously improve content across any platform. Matchpoint helps studios large and small operate at scale and improve performance and efficiency in an increasingly fragmented distribution environment. Additionally, Cineverse distributes a vast library of premium films, series, and podcasts, across theatrical, home entertainment, and streaming; operates dozens of digital properties that super serve passionate fandoms around the world; and works with leading brands to connect them with audiences they value. From award-winning technology to the highest-grossing unrated film in U.S. history, Cineverse has created a playbook that marries tech and content to redefine the next era of entertainment. For more information, visit cineverse.com.

releases.title: StyleWeekOC® 2026 and Newport Beach Film Festival Bring Star Power and High Style to Fashion Island
releases.body:
The 15th-anniversary celebration pairs West Coast style with cinematic storytelling for a week of high-profile premieres, exclusive parties, and scene-stealing fashion

NEWPORT BEACH, Calif., Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- StyleWeekOC® returns to Fashion Island in Newport Beach, CA from October 14–18, coinciding with the Newport Beach Film Festival from October 15–22, anchoring the West Coast cultural calendar along the California Riviera. This year's headliner is the always-stylish California native Jamie Chung—actress, podcaster, and editorial favorite—who hits our stage before filming her upcoming feature film alongside Miles Teller. Notable celebrity appearances also include an Author Talk with Emmy award-winning television personality Keltie Knight, moderated by The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills alumni Crystal Kung Minkoff, and an appearance by ten-year-old designer Max Alexander at the West Coast documentary premiere of Couture to the Max.

Since joining forces three years ago, the two festivals have created a powerful Southern California destination for style, culture, and conversation. The immersive five-day fashion event features brand activations, industry panels, fashion shows, and a glittering opening night. Additional celebrity panelists are set to join this already star-studded event, with names to be revealed in the weeks ahead.  

Together, StyleWeekOC® and Newport Beach Film Festival continue to energize the cultural landscape, building on the star-studded momentum of last year's event. Among those in attendance for the 2025 edition were Jacob Elordi, Penn Badgley, Ashley Park, and Noah Schnapp, alongside fashion-centric screenings including the documentary premiere of Thom Browne: The Man Who Tailors Dreams.

This year's StyleWeekOC® theme, Sunlit Glamoratti, captures a legendary sun-dappled backdrop through a Hollywood lens. The calendar includes a variety of fashion, beauty, and lifestyle offerings, such as a Red Carpet Ready Beauty Event with Bloomingdale's, On the Scent: Guerlain Fragrance Masterclass with Neiman Marcus, and a high-octane culinary event where fashion is the main dish featuring fashion retailers St. John, Alice + Olivia, L'Agence, Varley, Todd Synder, Arc'teryx, and Monica Vinader paired with spirits brand Rémy Cointreau and culinary destinations Telefèric Barcelona and Cucina Enoteca.

The programming reinforces Fashion Island's position as a definitive style and culinary epicenter. Fashion Island continues to solidify its status as a premier shopping destination with exclusive new store openings, including Ralph Lauren, British lifestyle brand Varley, and Rothy's, as well as eateries including New York's legendary Levain Bakery, Telefèric Barcelona, and Ralph's Coffee, which made headlines with its exclusive Southern California debut. Coming soon: Brazilian fashion house Farm Rio, Bobbi Brown's Jones Road Beauty, and viral lifestyle brand Hill House Home. 

Fashion Island is known for its curated mix of California brands, men's and women's fashion and home design. The portfolio features Neiman Marcus, Bloomingdale's, and Nordstrom, alongside OC market exclusives like RH, Ralph Lauren, Todd Snyder, Buck Mason, L'Agence, Rag & Bone, Cinq à Sept, Monica Vinader, Rails, PAIGE, and American Vintage.

"StyleWeekOC® continues to reinforce Fashion Island as a West Coast destination (or centerpiece) for style, and we're proud to bring that next-level experience to the Orange County community," said Gerard Widder, Vice President & General Manager at Fashion Island. "Our partnership with the Newport Beach Film Festival has elevated this event into something truly unique on the California Riviera, and this year's Sunlit Glamoratti theme captures exactly why people fall in love with Newport Beach."

Additional images found here. To purchase tickets and for additional information, visit www.StyleWeekOC.com and follow Fashion Island on Instagram at @fashionisland. Fashion Island is located at 401 Newport Center Drive, Newport Beach, CA 92660.

ABOUT STYLEWEEK OC

For the third year, StyleWeekOC® and the Newport Beach Film Festival join forces at Fashion Island to jolt the conversation between fashion and cinema. These two anchor events have evolved beyond their original boundaries, creating a cultural powerhouse that delivers high-profile film premieres, runway presentations, industry panels, and exclusive retail events along the California Riviera. Marking its 15th year, StyleWeekOC® is Orange County's definitive fashion event, celebrating style and social discovery. Now in its 28th year, the Newport Beach Film Festival is Southern California's leading cinematic showcase. From October 14–18, 2026, the collaboration is a five-day celebration of style and cinematic storytelling.

ABOUT FASHION ISLAND

At the epicenter of Newport Beach style and culture, Fashion Island is an open-air shopping and culinary destination reflecting the coastal Southern California lifestyle. As one of the iconic regional centers in the Irvine Company portfolio with a curated collection of 150 retailers and acclaimed restaurateurs, Fashion Island blends timeless luxury, emerging brands, world-class designers, uncommon boutiques, and remarkable dining options, attracting guests seeking exceptional retail experience. Visitors shop, dine and indulge in a lush resort-like setting with access to market exclusives like RH Newport Beach, L'Agence, Veronica Beard, Neiman Marcus, St. John, as well as culinary concepts Ocean 48, JOEY Newport Beach, Sushi Roku, True Food Kitchen, and more.

ABOUT THE NEWPORT BEACH FILM FESTIVAL

Recognized as one of the largest luxury lifestyle film festivals in the United States, the Newport Beach Film Festival brings together a globally curated slate of films and cultural events on the Southern California coast. The Festival is dedicated to showcasing contemporary screen culture, cinematic excellence, and championing visionary storytellers. Sponsors include UCI Health, Los Angeles Times, Visit Newport Beach, Fashion Island, and the City of Newport Beach. For the complete lineup, visit www.NewportBeachFilmFest.com.

releases.title: UNIVERSAL MUSIC GROUP APPOINTS ÒSCAR CELMA AS SENIOR VICE PRESIDENT, APPLIED AI AND MACHINE LEARNING
releases.body:
Former Spotify, Pandora/SiriusXM and Condé Nast executive brings more than two decades of expertise in AI, music discovery and personalization

SANTA MONICA, Calif., Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Music Group (UMG), the world leader in music-based entertainment, today announced the appointment of Òscar Celma as Senior Vice President, Applied AI and Machine Learning, effective immediately.

A recognized expert in AI, machine learning and music recommendation, Celma has helped shape how people discover and experience music. At Spotify, he helped lead the development of AI-powered personalized listening experiences including AI DJ, Jam and Daylist, as well as personalization and discovery products used by hundreds of millions of listeners worldwide.

Celma will help lead the development and application of AI and machine learning across UMG's global operations, supporting UMG's labels, divisions and businesses. He will report to Hannah Poferl, UMG's Chief Data Officer.

Hannah Poferl, UMG's Chief Data Officer, said, "Òscar brings a unique blend of quantitative and product experience, deep expertise in AI, and a love of music. He's built teams that have delivered and knows how to turn data at scale into useful insights. With the breadth and depth of UMG's data, there's enormous potential for him to help our teams do more for our artists."

Celma said, "I've spent much of my career exploring how technology can serve artists, songwriters and music fans. It's an exciting time to join Universal Music Group, given its industry leadership in using AI to expand what's creatively and commercially possible. I look forward to working with Hannah and leaders across UMG to advance our AI and machine learning capabilities to support human artistry.

Most recently, Celma led Machine Learning and Product Analytics at Condé Nast. Previously, as Director of Engineering at Spotify, he led engineering teams responsible for new listening experiences. He also spent seven years at Pandora/SiriusXM in senior data science leadership roles, focused on machine learning, music discovery, and recommendation. Earlier in his career, he was a Senior Research Scientist at Gracenote and co-founder and Chief Innovation Officer of Barcelona-based BMAT Music Innovators.

Celma holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science and Digital Communication from Universitat Pompeu Fabra in Barcelona and is a widely published researcher in music information retrieval and recommendation systems. He is the author of the Springer-published book Music Recommendation and Discovery.

About Universal Music Group

At Universal Music Group, we exist to shape culture through the power of artistry. UMG is the world leader in music-based entertainment, with a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content. Featuring the most comprehensive catalogue of recordings and songs across every musical genre, UMG identifies and develops artists and produces and distributes the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music in the world. Committed to artistry, innovation, and entrepreneurship, UMG fosters the development of services, platforms, and business models in order to broaden artistic and commercial opportunities for our artists and create new experiences for fans. For more information, visit www.universalmusic.com.

releases.title: From Multi-Platinum Recording Artist to Fashion Entrepreneur: Nailah Thorbourne Creates Vlair Shapewear for the Modern Woman
releases.body:
Brick & Lace artist, songwriter and entrepreneur transforms a personal fashion challenge into a shapewear line designed for today's boldest styles

MIAMI, Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- For women who love cut-out dresses, asymmetrical silhouettes, one-shoulder styles, sheer panels and other fashion-forward looks, finding the right shapewear can sometimes create a problem of its own. For Nailah Thorbourne, the multi-platinum recording artist, songwriter and entrepreneur known professionally as Nyla and as one-half of the internationally recognized music duo Brick & Lace, that challenge became the inspiration for a new fashion venture.

That solution is Vlair Shapewear, an online fashion brand created to provide women with shapewear designed to complement, rather than interfere with, today's bold clothing styles.

"I created Vlair because I saw a problem that needed to be solved, not just for myself, but for women who want to wear the clothes they love without having their shapewear work against the design," said Nailah Thorbourne, Founder/CEO of Vlair Shapewear. "I wanted to create something that allows a woman to put on that dress, step out and feel confident in what she's wearing."

MADE FOR THE CUT-OUTS

Traditional shapewear is often designed with conventional clothing silhouettes in mind. But today's fashion continues to embrace cut-outs, asymmetrical designs, one-shoulder styles, sheer panels and other looks that require a different approach to what is worn underneath.

Vlair was created with that reality in mind.

The brand's current collection includes shaper panties, shaper skirts, shaping bodysuits, shaper shorts and loungewear, with designs intended to work with a range of contemporary looks. The brand's signature positioning—"Made For the Cut Outs"—speaks directly to the fashion problem Vlair was created to address.

Among the collection is the Vlair Eclipse Bodysuit, which the company describes as being designed to disappear beneath one-shoulder dresses and sheer panels while helping provide shaping and support.

FROM THE STAGE TO THE FASHION INDUSTRY

Thorbourne brings a remarkable entertainment career to her role as a fashion entrepreneur. As a member of Brick & Lace, alongside her sister Nyanda Thorbourne, she helped establish an international recording career before continuing her work as a solo artist under the name Nyla.

Her career includes a significant collaboration with global electronic music group Major Lazer on the international hit "Light It Up." The song and its remix achieved platinum certifications in multiple international markets, with the remix featuring Nyla and Fuse ODG ultimately earning 2× Platinum certification in the United States.

In 2026, Thorbourne returned to the global stage when Nyla performed "Light It Up" with Major Lazer during the closing ceremony of the Milano Cortina 2026 Olympic Winter Games in Verona, Italy. The official ceremony program lists the performance as part of the closing celebration.

That combination of music, international performance and fashion experience has given Thorbourne a firsthand understanding of style, image and the importance of confidence when stepping in front of an audience.

With Vlair, Thorbourne is taking that experience in a new direction—creating a fashion brand built around a problem she believes modern women shouldn't have to accept.

"For me, Vlair is about more than shapewear. It's about giving women the freedom to wear the look they want to wear and feel good doing it," Thorbourne said. "The woman I designed Vlair for is bold, modern, and not afraid to step outside the box. She puts on the dress, walks through the door and owns the room."

DESIGNED FOR THE VLAIR WOMAN

Vlair describes its customer as "The Vlair Woman"—a woman who wears what she wants, how she wants, and approaches her style with intention.

The company's mission is to redefine shapewear for the modern woman through designs intended to promote confidence, individuality and the ability to wear today's boldest fashions.

Rather than asking women to change their fashion choices to accommodate traditional shapewear, Vlair takes the opposite approach: design shapewear to accommodate the fashion.

DISCOVER VLAIR SHAPEWEAR

Vlair Shapewear is available exclusively online, allowing customers to explore the collection and find pieces designed for their individual style.

To discover the collection and learn more about Vlair Shapewear, visit:

www.vlair.store 

ABOUT VLAIR SHAPEWEAR

Vlair Shapewear is a fashion-forward shapewear brand founded by multi-platinum recording artist, songwriter and entrepreneur Nailah Thorbourne, known professionally as Nyla and as one-half of Brick & Lace. Created from a personal need to solve the challenges of wearing shapewear beneath today's bold fashion silhouettes, Vlair is designed for the modern woman who wants to express her individuality without compromising confidence or style. With its "Made For the Cut Outs" philosophy, Vlair creates shapewear intended to work with contemporary fashion, including cut-outs, asymmetrical designs, one-shoulder styles and sheer looks.

The King of Trash, a hit documentary about the Duong family and their recycling company California Waste Solutions, has captivated communities all over California. This weekend, the last VIP screening of the movie in California in the latest tour takes place in San Jose. 

SAN JOSE, Calif., Sept. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The King of Trash, the feature documentary about Vietnamese-American entrepreneur David Duong and the family that built California Waste Solutions, Inc. and Vietnam Waste Solutions, returns to San Jose on Saturday for its final VIP pre-screening, with Duong, members of the cast, and director Errol Webber expected to meet the audience.
releases.title: Final Curtain of Latest Screenings of The King of Trash, The Sold-Out Movie About California Waste Solutions & David Duong, In San Jose & Emeryville
releases.body:
The King of Trash, a hit documentary about the Duong family and their recycling company California Waste Solutions, has captivated communities all over California. This weekend, the last VIP screening of the movie in California in the latest tour takes place in San Jose. 

SAN JOSE, Calif., Sept. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The King of Trash, the feature documentary about Vietnamese-American entrepreneur David Duong and the family that built California Waste Solutions, Inc. and Vietnam Waste Solutions, returns to San Jose on Saturday for its final VIP pre-screening, with Duong, members of the cast, and director Errol Webber expected to meet the audience.

The Saturday, September 26 program screens from 4:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. at AMC Eastridge, 2190 Eastridge Loop. It closes a new round of Bay Area public screenings that has drawn nearly 1,000 registrations and wait-list requests after an eight-city U.S. pre-screening tour that brought more than 5,000 people into theaters in San Jose, Oakland, Sacramento, Orange County, Dallas, Houston, Washington, D.C., and Orlando.

The film also screens Friday, September 25, at the 20th Red Rock Film Festival in St. George, Utah, where it was selected for the 2026 program. A further Bay Area date follows on Saturday, October 3, from 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. at AMC Bay Street Emeryville.

"We are absolutely amazed and thrilled at the reception for the movie," said David Duong, Founder & CEO of The King of Trash. "We honestly never expected anything like this. It's been very moving to see so many people touched by my family's story of arriving here on the shores of America, picking up trash by hand, and building CWS out into the wonderful company that it is today."

A Community Company

The work that goes on behind the scenes at California Waste Solutions to make the cities it operates in clean, green and pretty are laid out in painstaking detail in The King of Trash, as well as the enormous sacrifices that went into making it all happen.

Crews are on the yard before most neighborhoods are awake; drivers and operations staff inspect trucks, check equipment, and walk the day's routes; once the fleet leaves the gate, collection moves through traffic that changes block by block. At the facilities, incoming material is received, flow is managed, and processing is kept in step with the street. Mechanics keep both the trucks and the sorting lines in service. When weather, volume, or street conditions change at a moment's notice, crews adjust. The work never stops.

"For most people, recycling is part of a routine they rarely think about," said Michael Duong, President of California Waste Solutions. "In our business, that usually means a win. At the same time, educating people about recycling and the importance of this vital service is also something we've tried really hard to do over the past few years, and hopefully The King of Trash succeeds with this a little. We like to think so."

The company measures reliability less by tonnage than by whether residents can depend on the service without having to think about it. Pre-dawn preparation, coordination between people and machines, and the refusal to treat any honest job as small are the same disciplines that took the Duong family from a single truck to a municipal recycling franchise serving two major California cities. The King of Trash records that continuity in documentary footage and in several dramatized sequences drawn from the company's own history.

Closing Out In San Jose

San Jose is being treated as the natural close for the VIP series. It is a California Waste Solutions service city and home to one of the largest Vietnamese-American communities in the country. For many families in the room, the history on screen is not distant. Meanwhile, the last showing of the current screening run will come to an end in Emeryville, close to the Duong family's Oakland home roots.

"We came to this country with nothing but hope. Everything we built came from hard work and faith," said David Duong. "The movie is as much an homage to the places we were able to build the company into what it is today, and the wonderful, conscientious people in it who are our customers and employees."

Directed by Oscar-winning cinematographer Errol Webber, the 72-minute documentary traces the Duong family's escape from Saigon in April 1975, the open-sea crossing, a refugee camp in the Philippines, and the years of street-level recycling in San Francisco that grew into one of Northern California's major family-owned environmental services companies and a large-scale waste-management operation in Vietnam.

The new Bay Area run has drawn packed houses and unusually strong word of mouth from immigrant families who say the film is their story, not a corporate profile. Earlier dates in the current cycle included a sold-through showing in Hayward and a special screening in Dublin on September 19.

The production is preparing for official release and global distribution and has also been selected for the 2026 San Francisco International New Concept Film Festival.

The King of Trash California Screening schedule

San Jose: Saturday, Sept. 26, 4-8 p.m., AMC Eastridge 15, 2190 Eastridge Loop. Final VIP red-carpet prescreening.

Emeryville: Saturday, Oct. 3, 5-7 p.m., AMC Bay Street 16, 5614 Bay St., Suite 220. Free and open to the public.

Registration: TheKingofTrash.us. Seating is limited.

About The King of Trash

The King of Trash is a feature documentary directed by Errol Webber. It tells the true story of David Duong and the Duong family, Vietnamese refugees who survived the fall of Saigon, rebuilt their lives in America, and founded California Waste Solutions and Vietnam Waste Solutions. Official site: www.thekingoftrash.us. Media: info@thekingoftrash.us.

About California Waste Solutions

Founded in 1992 by David Duong, California Waste Solutions provides recycling collection, processing, customer service, and material recovery for residential, commercial, and municipal customers in Northern California, including Oakland and San José. Through its subsidiary Vietnam Waste Solutions, the company also operates large-scale environmental infrastructure in Ho Chi Minh City. Headquarters: 1211 Embarcadero, Suite 300, Oakland, CA 94606. www.calwaste.com.

OKLAHOMA CITY, Sept. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- After careful consideration, Exchange Traded Concepts, LLC, the Fund's investment adviser has recommended, and the Board of Trustees of Exchange Traded Concepts Trust has approved, the termination and liquidation of the Fund pursuant to the terms of a Plan of Liquidation. Accordingly, the Fund is expected to cease operations and liquidate on or about October 23, 2026 (the "Liquidation Date").

The Fund will be closed to orders for new creation units on October 19, 2026, and the last day of trading of the Fund's shares on the NYSE Arca, Inc. will be on or about October 20, 2026. From October 19, 2026 through the last day of trading, shareholders may only be able to sell their shares to certain broker-dealers, and there is no assurance that there will be a market for Fund shares during that time period. releases.title: MELLODY FARM HARVEST FESTIVAL RETURNS OCT. 24 WITH LIVE MUSIC, FOOD AND DRINK TASTINGS, PET ADOPTIONS AND FALL FAMILY FUN
releases.body:
Daylong Vernon Hills Event Will Feature The Harvest Haul, Illinois Agriculture Programming, Yappy Hour With Lazy Dog, Bites & Sips And Bourbon & Bonfires

VERNON HILLS, Ill., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mellody Farm celebrates the season with its annual Harvest Festival on Sat., Oct. 24, from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m., bringing together fall activities, live entertainment, food and beverage experiences, pet-friendly programming, and community fundraising throughout the shopping center.

The daylong festival features free activities beginning at 10 a.m., followed by ticketed Harvest Festival Bites & Sips and Bourbon & Bonfires experiences from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Proceeds from the event will benefit the Hawthorn School District PTO.

A centerpiece of this year's festival will be the Mellody Farm Harvest Haul, a shopping center-wide experience encouraging guests to "Fill Your Basket Around the Farm." Guests can pick up a free Harvest Haul card at festival check-in and visit participating retailers, restaurants and activities throughout Mellody Farm to collect fall-themed stickers. Guests who complete at least eight participating stops can return their cards to receive a free fall-themed Mellody Farm item, while supplies last, and be entered to win prizes.

The grand-prize package will be highlighted by a two-night family getaway to Eagle Ridge Resort & Spa and will include additional prizes and experiences from Mellody Farm businesses, including a Hydrafacial from OVME Medical Aesthetics, retail items from European Wax Center, a prize from SITKA Gear and additional dining, merchandise and tenant contributions.

From 10 a.m. to early afternoon, the festival will also feature an Illinois Agriculture & Urban Farm Zone. From 10 to 11:30 a.m., guests can take part in a free "Winterizing Your Garden" workshop, offering seasonal tips and practical guidance for preparing home gardens for the colder months. The morning programming also features Biscuits & Bloody Marys, a special Bites & Sips offering with biscuits and seasonal beverages, including lemonade, cider and Bloody Marys.

Representatives from the Lake County Farm Bureau, University of Illinois Extension and Illinois Sustainable Agriculture Partnership are also participating with activities and conversations focused on Illinois agriculture, urban farming, soil health, sustainability, gardening and local hunger-relief efforts.

Throughout the center from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., guests will encounter roaming entertainment. Programming includes a mix of face painting, balloon artists, photo opportunities, seasonal characters and Mellody Farm's four-legged ambassador, Keenam, who will make appearances throughout the property.

From 1 p.m. to 2 p.m., Yappy Hour presented by Lazy Dog will put the spotlight on Mellody Farm's canine guests. The pet-friendly event is planned to include a fall pet costume contest, pet photo opportunities, giveaways and a pet rescue and adoption event with PAWS Chicago. Costumed pets and their owners also will be invited to join a festive pet parade through Mellody Farm.

Beginning at 4 p.m., the festival will transition into its primary evening celebration with live music from Big Boss and the Toes and a Harvest Festival Bites & Sips experience. The festival will feature approximately six Bites & Sips stations with participating restaurants including City Works, Tangled Roots, Mendocino Farms and Lazy Dog. Offerings will range from meatloaf sliders and pretzels to beer, house-made lemonade and other seasonal bites and beverages.

A separate Bourbon & Bonfires experience with Aged in Oak will feature bourbon tastings, curated flights, bourbon education and gathering areas around Mellody Farm's fire pits.

Tickets are $35 for Harvest Festival Bites & Sips, $35 for Bourbon & Bonfires or $55 for a package that includes both experiences. A $20 designated driver ticket also will be available. Most daytime festival programming is free and open to the public.

The festival also will help launch Mellody Farm's seasonal community giving initiative, encouraging guests to donate nonperishable food and clothing to support local families and hunger-relief efforts.

The Harvest Haul Grand Prize will be announced at approximately 7:30 p.m., and the festival will conclude at 8 p.m. Guests are encouraged to remain at Mellody Farm for dinner, drinks and evening shopping.

Harvest Festival Bites & Sips tickets can be purchased online at omella.com/267p5. Additional festival programming and participating businesses can be found at www.mellodyfarm.com.

About Mellody Farm

Located in the heart of Vernon Hills, Illinois, Mellody Farm is an open-air shopping, dining and lifestyle destination owned and operated by Regency Centers. Conveniently located at the corner of Milwaukee Avenue and Townline Road, just two miles west of Interstate 94, the center features approximately 270,000 square feet of retail, restaurants and entertainment alongside 260 executive apartments. Designed as a vibrant community gathering place, Mellody Farm offers a thoughtfully curated mix of national retailers, local dining experiences and year-round events that bring people together through shopping, dining, wellness and community engagement.

releases.title: Ventura Music Festival's Fall Series Brings Diverse Live Music to Iconic Ventura Venues, Oct. 11-18
releases.body:
Five events from October 11-18 feature Grammy-winning jazz and vocals in A Tribute to Quincy Jones, unique classical featuring both storytelling and rock, bluegrass legends Carter and Cleveland, and a special holiday choral finale in December from Chanticleer

  • Fall Series runs October 11 through 18, with a holiday concert December 15
  • Pacific Jazz Orchestra brings A Tribute to Quincy Jones on Oct 18 at Rancho Campana PAC; Grammy-nominated conductor Chris Walden leads, featuring vocalists Nayanna Holley, Adam "Aejaye" Jackson
  • Bluegrass Fiddle Legends Michael Cleveland and Jason Carter perform at Mission Park on October 17
  • Season closes December 15 with Chanticleer at Ventura Center for Spiritual Living
  • Tickets on sale now at venturamusicfestival.org

VENTURA, Calif., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Ventura Music Festival (VMF) proudly presents its 2026 Fall Series, a 5-event run in October featuring an exceptional range of world-class performers across jazz, classical, and bluegrass, with a special holiday concert in December from the choral institution, Chanticleer. Presented across beloved, iconic venues throughout Ventura County, the Fall Series delivers genre-spanning programming rooted in VMF's 31-year commitment to musical excellence and community access.

Tea and Trumpets | Sunday, October 11 | 3 PM

The Fall Series opens with Tea and Trumpets, VMF's signature intimate experience pairing an elegant afternoon tea service with live brass quintet performance. A local favorite, the event returns by popular demand for another season, hosted at the historic Pierpont Inn.

Birth of Impressionism | Thursday, October 15 | The Museum of Ventura County | 7 PM

VMF's popular Classical Edge Concert format returns with Birth of Impressionism, an evening that is part performance, part history, and part discovery. Led by VMF Artistic Director and violinist Nuvi Mehta, the event takes audiences inside a pivotal moment in musical history, bringing the ideas and sounds of the Impressionist movement to life through storytelling and live music.

TAKE3: Where Rock Meets Bach | Friday, October 16 | Ventura Music Hall | 7 PM

On Friday, October 16, TAKE3 takes the stage at Ventura Music Hall for a genre-smashing evening that pairs the technical precision of Bach with the energy and irreverence of rock. The violin, cello, and piano trio -- conservatory-trained and rock-star electrifying -- has built a devoted following for performances as surprising as they are virtuosic. This event is ticketed directly through Ventura Music Hall.

Michael Cleveland and Jason Carter | Saturday, October 17 | Mission Park, Ventura | 5 PM

On Saturday, October 17, VMF brings the two most decorated fiddle players in the history of the International Bluegrass Music Association to Mission Park in Ventura. Michael Cleveland, a 12-time IBMA Fiddle Player of the Year, joins 6-time winner Jason Carter for an outdoor performance that celebrates the finest traditions of American roots music in one of Ventura's most beloved community settings. Sponsored by Vita Arts Center, The Welcome Room, Ofi Property and Daly Group

Pacific Jazz Orchestra: A Tribute to Quincy Jones | Sunday, October 18 | Rancho Campana Performing Arts Center, Camarillo | 3 PM

The Fall Series centerpiece brings Pacific Jazz Orchestra to Rancho Campana Performing Arts Center for an exploration of Quincy Jones' masterful early work from the 1950s and 60s. Seven-time Grammy-nominated Artistic Director and conductor Chris Walden -- who counts Jones himself among his mentors -- leads the group's 19-piece Big Band Ensemble through original arrangements drawn from Jones' groundbreaking recordings, his arrangements for legendary singers including Frank Sinatra and Sarah Vaughan, and his film scoring work on landmarks such as The Pawnbroker (1964) and In the Heat of the Night (1967).

Guest vocalists Nayanna Holley and Adam "Aejaye" Jackson join for the occasion. Holley, a longtime member of the house band for NBC's The Voice, brings extraordinary range as a performer and vocal contractor whose credits span The Color Purple, Encanto, and The Academy Awards. Jackson, a Detroit-born vocalist, songwriter, and actor, brings a soulful blend of R&B, soul, and jazz shaped by decades of collaboration with artists including Stevie Wonder, Josh Groban, Toni Braxton, and David Foster.

Pacific Jazz Orchestra has garnered critical acclaim for performances that "entertain, inspire, and enrich" (Variety). The 40-piece Los Angeles-based ensemble is recognized as the city's first resident jazz orchestra since 2006. Tickets for the October 18 concert are $15 -- $109, available at venturamusicfestival.org or by calling (805) 648-3146. The concert takes place at Rancho Campana Performing Arts Center, 4235 Mar Vista Drive, Camarillo, CA 93010.

Chanticleer | Tuesday, December 15 | Ventura Center for Spiritual Living | 7 PM

VMF's 31st season closes December 15 with a special holiday concert from Chanticleer, the celebrated twelve-voice male ensemble that has sold over one million recordings and performed thousands of concerts across the globe. Named for the clear-singing rooster in Geoffrey Chaucer's Canterbury Tales, the ensemble spans countertenor to bass and performs five centuries of choral music with breathtaking precision. The performance at Ventura Center for Spiritual Living brings the season to a warm and luminous close.

Tickets

Tickets for all VMF-presented Fall Series events are on sale now at venturamusicfestival.org or by calling (805) 648-3146. VMF also offers subsidized ticket pricing and free programming to ensure music remains accessible throughout the community.

About the Ventura Music Festival

A 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization since 1995, the Ventura Music Festival has been a cornerstone of cultural life in Ventura for over thirty years, presenting world-class performances while championing music education and free community programming. VMF's Music in the Schools program serves more than 1,600 students annually, and the organization delivers free community concerts each season, reaching a total community audience of 10,100+. The 2026 season is presented with generous support from Impresario Season Sponsors, the John and Glenda Hammer Family. For tickets and information, visit venturamusicfestival.org or call (805) 648-3146.

releases.title: Annapolis Jazz & Roots Festival Offers Music, History and Culture November 6-15
releases.body:
ANNAPOLIS, Md., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Annapolis Jazz & Roots is launching its fifth festival on the scenic shores of the Chesapeake Bay. Enjoy music, art, poetry and history on two weekends, November 6-15. Based in the maritime community of Eastport, the festival includes eight venues in five neighborhoods. Each has its own distinct character and charm. Festival goers can visit centuries old buildings, take in restorative bay views and stroll the tree-lined streets of the historic Maryland city.

THEME AND HIGHLIGHTS

The 2026 theme "New World Music: Centuries of Sound" will be brought home by international and regional performers. An adventurous lineup includes programs rooted in history and culture from colonial days to modern times. Trace the evolution of music and culture since the days Indigenous tribes walked the forests and rode the waters. Gain new insights into the startling history and lasting legacy of slavery and indenture in Maryland; delve into the soulful roots of jazz, and celebrate the changing color of sound in America.

Events are free or require modest admission, and all but two venues offer free onsite parking. Reservations are strongly advised for all events. Visit instantseats.com ( https://instnt.us/AJRF ).

WEEKEND ONE

Opening Night takes place Friday, November 6 at 7:00 p.m. at St. Luke's Episcopal Church in Eastport. Jazz lovers will appreciate how the intimacy and beautiful acoustics of the venue elevate the listening experience when the Muneer Nasser Band performs.

Trumpeter Muneer Nasser was exposed to great music by his father, jazz bassist Jamil Nasser. His concert pays homage to three legendary musicians born in 1926: John Coltrane, Miles Davis and Randy Weston. Their brave explorations led to seismic shifts in the sonic landscape and continue to resonate around the globe.

On Saturday at 11:00 a.m. visit Eastport-Annapolis Neck Library to learn about slavery and indenture in colonial times. Lecturer William Kelly, Ph.D. is a research archivist and historian at the Maryland State Archives. His event concludes a Q & A.

The second November 7 offering will be held at Peerless Rens Club, an historic Black social club. Listeners will be blown away by Perkutao, an Afro Peruvian band formed in Lima, Peru! Catch shows at 4:00 p.m. or 6:00 p.m. Food and bar beverages will be on sale.

Two amazing shows await music lovers on Sunday. At 2:00 p.m. David and Ginger Hildebrand will play colonial music on period instruments at Unitarian Universalist Church of Annapolis. The richly entertaining concert pays tribute to General Lafayette, the French nobleman who won American hearts during the American Revolutionary War.

At 7:00 p.m. the focus shifts to modern-day America when musician Makaya McCraven appears at Maryland Hall. The drummer and composer transforms jazz through a bold blend of improvisation, hip-hop production, and global musical traditions. For this show only, purchase tickets from the venue: https://my.marylandhall.org/makayamccraven.

WEEKEND TWO

On Friday, November 13 at 7:00 p.m., Eastport UM Church hosts the U.S.N.A. Band's Superintendent's Combo in a tribute to Miles Davis. The event is dedicated to the late Annapolis musician and lifelong arts volunteer "TEA" Arthur and concludes with a public reception.

Jazz fans may want to chug their Saturday morning coffee to reach Eastport-Annapolis Neck Library by 11:00 a.m. NY jazz vocalist Vanessa Racci will review the many Italian contributions to American jazz. The award-winning artist has delivered her colorful presentation at Rutgers University, The Generoso Pope Italian American Cultural Center and The Italian American Museum of NYC.

A jazz artist of extraordinary talent and crowd-moving passion, Akua Allrich appears Saturday at 2:00 p.m. at Banneker-Douglass-Tubman Museum. Rooted in blues, soul, and R & B, the D.C. vocalist has electrified international audiences through concerts and recordings. On November 14, she celebrates the release of her 2026 album Bonya and pays tribute to two legendary artists and civil rights activists: South Africa's Miriam Makeba (1932-2008) and America's Nina Simone (1933-2003).  Visitors can see a related art exhibition before the show. She Speaks: Black Women Artists and the Power of Historical Memory examines 250 years of American history through a Black Feminist lens.

The closing event on Sunday at 2:00 p.m. features Uhwachi-Reh at Pip Moyer Recreation Center. Led by Louis Campbell (Lumbee), the Indigenous troupe performs traditional dance in ceremonial regalia with live drumming and singing. Also appearing are Denmi Whiteman (Lakota), Angela Miracle Gladue (Cree), and Keith Colston (Lumbee -Tuscarora). They've appeared at community events, the Baltimore Museum of Art, the Maryland Folklife Festival and The Kennedy Center.

Annapolis Jazz & Roots is an affiliate under the umbrella of the Annapolis Community Foundation. AJRF is grateful for support from the Maryland State Arts Council, Arts Council of Anne Arundel County, the City of Annapolis, Anne Arundel County Library & Foundation and Jazz Beyond Borders. Visit annapolisjazzandrootsfestival.com for more information.

releases.title: Pipit Takes a New Approach to Independent Music Discovery and Artist Support
releases.body:
Built only for independent artists, Pipit combines direct fan support and fan-driven discovery, with no major-label artists and no generative-AI music.

VALPARAISO, Ind., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Pipit, a new music platform built exclusively for independent artists and the fans who want to discover and support them, today announced that its platform is officially open for artist sign-ups.

Independent artists can now create a free Pipit profile, upload their music, build their presence, and begin connecting their existing fan base to Pipit ahead of the platform's broader fan launch.

Pipit was created around a simple idea: independent artists need more than another place to upload music. They need a place where music discovery, artist support, and the artist-to-fan relationship can live together.

Direct Support for Artists

One of Pipit's central features is Support. Artists receive a personalized Pipit Support invite they can share with followers through social media, websites, email, text messages, and other channels.

Fans can join Pipit for just $3.99 per month and choose an independent artist to support, with $2 of that monthly membership going directly to the artist. Supporters can also stream that artist's full catalog on Pipit during the month they support them. A relatively small community of committed supporters can create meaningful recurring revenue.

Social Built Into the Music Experience

Pipit also brings the social relationship directly into the platform. Through Pipit's integrated Social Feed, artists can share updates, photos, videos, performances, and behind-the-scenes moments with the people discovering and supporting their music.

Instead of releasing music on one platform, promoting it on another, posting videos elsewhere, and hoping an algorithm lets followers see it, Pipit brings those interactions closer together.

Discovery Chosen by the Listener

Pipit's Discover Wave gives listeners a more active role in music discovery. Nine musical categories define songs on Pipit: Genre, Flow/Journey, Mood, Sound, Vocals, Lyrics, Tempo, Studio/Production, and Region.

Listeners use those same categories to build their own Discover Waves and explore music based on what they want to hear, rather than relying entirely on a platform-generated playlist.

"Music discovery shouldn't be something that happens to you," Shingler said. "It should be something you drive."

Discover Waves are also designed to remain alive, allowing newly added songs that match a listener's preferences to enter existing Waves over time.

No Major Labels. No Generative-AI Music.

Pipit is intentionally being built as an independent-music ecosystem. The platform does not accept major-label artists and has established a no-generative-AI music policy for artist uploads.

Artists certify that they did not use generative AI to create or replace lyrics, melody, composition, vocals, instrumentals, backing tracks, or musical arrangement.

Artists can join Pipit for free. In addition to direct fan Support, Pipit plans to compensate qualifying discovery streams at $0.005 per stream as its discovery offering expands.

Thinking Outside the Box & Inside the Crate

When the team began designing Pipit, they did not start by asking how to build another version of an existing streaming service.

They looked further back.

Before recommendation algorithms and automatically generated playlists, music discovery required participation. People flipped through records, dug through crates, asked friends what they were listening to, and took chances on artists they had never heard before.

"We wanted to think outside the box of today's music platforms and, in a way, inside the crate of old-school music discovery," Shingler said. "Technology should make discovering independent music easier without taking the listener out of the discovery process."

Independent artists can create an account and begin uploading music now at indiepipit.com.

About Pipit, Inc.

Pipit, Inc. is a five-person technology company building a music platform exclusively for independent artists and the fans who want to discover and support them.

The founding team brings together experience in business, product development, software engineering, front-end development, and user experience design. Pipit combines modern technology with the curiosity and participation that once came from digging through a crate of records looking for something new.

For more information, visit www.indiepipit.com.

releases.title: "We've Got Heart in Boston": From Three-Deckers to Ducklings, Here's a Song That Puts Boston's "Yeah, That's Us" Moments to Music
releases.body:
Daria MonDesire Delivers a Spirited Song About Boston's Quirks, Character, and Its Knack for Making the Letter 'R' Disappear

BOSTON, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Finish this sentence: If you see a chair in the street after a snowstorm, it's there to _________________.

If you know the answer, you just might be from Boston.

Roxbury-born Songwriter Daria MonDesire salutes her hometown with the release of her new single, "We've Got Heart in Boston." Available September 25th across all major streaming platforms.

The lyrics pay homage to the city's no-nonsense, 'Boston Charming' ethos, and celebrate even the scofflaws who call dibs on shoveled out parking spaces.

The release, produced by Peter Young of Nashville, features MonDesire on vocals; or, as she quips, "unfeatures." "I sang because the song is meant for every Boston-lover and every voice," says MonDesire. "No Rihannas required. All you need is pride in the city."

The song's arrangement showcases a mélange of West African and Celtic drumming, Irish tin whistle, and a touch of Bahian rhythm. As for the Boston accent in the vocals, "That's how I sound," says MonDesire. "I wanted to honor the fact that Boston is a diverse city. There's a misperception that the Boston accent is a White accent. But I can't tell you the number of times people have tried to get me to say "park the car in the Harvard yard." Bostonians of any ethnicity can have a Boston accent, and often do."

releases.title: Joe Granda to Receive Two 2026 Honors Celebrating More Than Five Decades in Music and Entertainment
releases.body:
His work spans Latin and crossover music, remix production, live events and LGBTQIA+ audience outreach.

MIAMI, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Joe Granda, founder and CEO of Granda Entertainment, will receive two honors in October recognizing a 53-year career in music and entertainment, including his work promoting Latin artists and connecting them with English-speaking and LGBTQIA+ audiences.

Granda will receive the "Empresario Internacional del Año" recognition at the Golden Music Awards in Orlando on October 1. On October 16, Unity Coalition | Coalición Unida will recognize his contributions and artistic vision at the ORGULLO Honors Awards Dinner & Fashion Show in Miami Beach.

Early in Shakira's career, Sony executive Oscar Llord hired Granda Entertainment to market and promote her Radio y Música showcase. Granda later handled separate LGBTQ+ marketing and promotion projects for Shakira over the years. Most recently, he worked on remixes of her 2024 single "Soltera."

Granda also recently executive-produced dance remixes of Gloria Estefan's "La Vecina (No Sé Na')," a single from Raíces, the winner of the 2026 Grammy Award for Best Tropical Latin Album. His work with Estefan has also included promotion to LGBTQIA+ audiences.

His executive production credits include remixes of Thalía's "A Quién Le Importa," Gloria Trevi's "Todos Me Miran," Ricky Martin's "María" and "She Bangs," and Paulina Rubio's "Don't Say Goodbye." He also executive-produced Celia Cruz In The House and remixes of La India's "Seduce Me Now," which won Latin Dance Club Play Track of the Year at the 2004 Billboard Latin Music Awards. Other projects involved Christina Aguilera, Madonna, Village People, Gloria Gaynor and Evelyn Thomas.

Granda also thanked the companies that have placed their trust in him and Granda Entertainment over the years, including Sony Music, Universal Music, Warner Music and Live Nation, among others.

Granda's promotional work includes LGBTQIA+ tours for Latin artists such as Elvis Crespo, Fey, La India, Lucía Méndez and Ivy Queen, who received a special recognition from GLAAD in 2008. Through Pride stages and promotional events, he has helped connect Latin music with LGBTQIA+ audiences.

For approximately 15 years, Granda produced Viva la Música at SeaWorld Orlando and Busch Gardens Tampa. The event brought Latin music to family audiences, with performers including salsa artists Víctor Manuelle, Gilberto Santa Rosa and Jerry Rivera, as well as reggaeton artists Daddy Yankee, Don Omar and Zion & Lennox.

Born in Cuba and raised in Hialeah, Granda began his professional music career in 1973 with Miami band Majesty. He later co-wrote and produced "Diamond Girl" by Nice & Wild. According to Granda, the song spent approximately 27 weeks on Billboard's dance and crossover charts and was among the first songs with a Spanish-language verse to receive airplay on R&B radio.

"I'm halfway between both worlds. That's why crossover came naturally to me," Granda said of his Latin and Anglo musical influences.

His current projects include Incluvision, a music label dedicated to LGBTQIA+ artists, and a streaming TV channel for LGBTQIA+ Latino audiences.

The ORGULLO dinner will take place October 16 at 6:30 p.m. at Fogo de Chão, 836 1st Street, Miami Beach. Event information is available at CelebrateORGULLO.com.

Granda is available for interviews in English and Spanish about his music career, Latin artist promotion, LGBTQIA+ audience outreach, and live entertainment and event production. Photos and interview arrangements are available through Granda Entertainment Press.

About Granda Entertainment

Granda Entertainment provides artist development, production, marketing, promotion and consulting across Latin, Anglo, crossover and LGBTQIA+ markets.

While attending Milwaukee Area Technical College and Marquette University, Ashanti studied advanced music theory under the legendary Tony King—foundational creator of the renowned jazz program at the Wisconsin Conservatory of Music (the "Berklee of the Midwest"). During this formative era, Ashanti also honed his pristine vocal technique under the intensive guidance of renowned jazz vocalist Jessie Hauck.

This elite foundation directly fueled Ashanti's legacy as an influential culture architect, notably serving as a primary pre-fame mentor to stic.man of the iconic, revolutionary hip-hop duo Dead Prez. Furthermore, legendary industry force Shaheed Najm—creative visionary and father of trailblazing icon T-Pain—served as a core creative consultant on this new project alignment.

In a commanding sonic blueprint, the track was produced, mixed, and mastered entirely in South Florida by legendary platinum hitmaker Tony Castillo, professionally known as Gorilla Tek. Renowned for dropping some of the heaviest regional sub-bass bangers for icons like Trina, Gorilla Tek crafted the song's earth-shaking beat down in South Florida.

The Anthem for Self-Belief

GREENWICH, Conn., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- O'Shaughnessy Ventures LLC (OSV), an investment firm that empowers creators, has awarded an O'Shaughnessy Fellowship to Dimitri Vallein, a filmmaker and technologist based in Paris.

Vallein will use the fellowship to complete "The Day I Met You," an immersive science-fiction short film that brings quantum physics into an intimate story about love, choice and the nature of reality, made for both cinema screens and virtual reality. He is capturing actors' performances with 4D Gaussian splatting, a technique that surrounds performers with about 200 synchronized cameras and reconstructs their movement as a photorealistic three-dimensional image a viewer can walk around, rather than as flat footage fixed to a single camera angle. He then places those performances inside digital environments. Over the next 12 months, he plans to finish the film and pursue an international festival premiere.

releases.body:
Dimitri Vallein receives an O'Shaughnessy Fellowship to complete "The Day I Met You," a science-fiction short that films its actors in three dimensions using 4D Gaussian splatting.

GREENWICH, Conn., Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- O'Shaughnessy Ventures LLC (OSV), an investment firm that empowers creators, has awarded an O'Shaughnessy Fellowship to Dimitri Vallein, a filmmaker and technologist based in Paris.

Vallein will use the fellowship to complete "The Day I Met You," an immersive science-fiction short film that brings quantum physics into an intimate story about love, choice and the nature of reality, made for both cinema screens and virtual reality. He is capturing actors' performances with 4D Gaussian splatting, a technique that surrounds performers with about 200 synchronized cameras and reconstructs their movement as a photorealistic three-dimensional image a viewer can walk around, rather than as flat footage fixed to a single camera angle. He then places those performances inside digital environments. Over the next 12 months, he plans to finish the film and pursue an international festival premiere.

Vallein is building Revery, an entertainment company developing original stories for film, games and immersive formats. His animated short films have earned more than 40 international festival selections. Previously, he built augmented reality experiences on Meta's Spark AR platform for brands and artists, including Netflix and Dua Lipa. His work has drawn hundreds of millions of views across social media.

OSV's founder and CEO, Jim O'Shaughnessy, commented, "I've long argued that modern science fiction has abandoned any belief in a better future. Dimitri's approach combines two of my favorite things: positive ideas and cutting-edge technology. We're delighted to be backing him."

"I want to make beautiful films that bring our most extraordinary scientific and philosophical ideas into popular culture," said Vallein. "Receiving an O'Shaughnessy Fellowship will help me bring that vision to life. I'm grateful to the OSV team for believing in ambitious ideas before the path is obvious."

About the O'Shaughnessy Fellowships Program

Launched in 2023, the O'Shaughnessy Fellowships program discovers and empowers the world's boldest creatives, builders and researchers. Fellows receive a grant of up to $100,000 and gain access to OSV's network of founders, investors and experts.

Vallein is the twenty-third fellow announced in 2026. More information about previous fellows is available at OSV's website.

Applications for the O'Shaughnessy Fellowships are now closed and will reopen on Jan. 1, 2027. Individuals interested in applying can do so via OSV's website.

About O'Shaughnessy Ventures

OSV is a creative investment firm that empowers creators to bring their ideas to life. Founded by Jim O'Shaughnessy, a pioneer in quantitative investing, founder of O'Shaughnessy Asset Management, and author of five books, OSV aims to provide financial support and to partner in growing the next life-changing creative ideas.

OSV combines Jim's deeply rooted interest in all things art, science, investing and technology with his long-held desire to establish scenarios designed to help promising creators and their inspiring ideas succeed, regardless of age, location, job history or level of education. For more information, visit OSV's website.

Other highlights included the Xi'an International VR Film Exchange, the "Starry Brilliance" High‑Quality Micro‑Drama Programme, the Silk Road Film Market, Silk Road Film Exchanges, screenings and promotions for low‑and‑medium‑budget Shaanxi films, and the SRIFF Young Talent Venture Initiative, fostering international collaboration, industrial integration and youth talent development.

releases.title: COUNTRY MUSIC HALL OF FAME® AND MUSEUM TO OPEN NEW EXHIBITION, ROGER MILLER: WIT, WISDOM, AND WONDER
releases.body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn., Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum will explore the life and career of Country Music Hall of Fame member Roger Miller in a new exhibition. Roger Miller: Wit, Wisdom, and Wonder follows the story of the musical savant whose multifaceted career earned him a flood of accolades and widespread affection from the public. The exhibit is included with museum admission and runs from Friday, Nov. 6, until March 2028. It is supported by All Access Coach Leasing.

Miller (1936-1992) became a country-pop superstar in the 1960s with self-penned crossover hits like "Dang Me" and "King of the Road." At the height of the British Invasion, Miller won 11 Grammy awards, and he was the first country artist to win a Tony. He was a true renaissance man, mastering multiple crafts as a songwriter, singer, fiddler, guitarist, drummer, film and television star, Las Vegas headliner and Broadway composer.

Recognized for his quick wit, Miller's natural comedic ability was so sharp that Nashville songwriters were known to trail him around town, hoping to collect lines that flew from his mouth. He counted songwriting giants Bill Anderson and Willie Nelson among his closest friends, and has influenced countless others, including John Prine, Toby Keith and Kacey Musgraves.

"Roger Miller was a singular creative force," said Kyle Young, CEO of the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum. "Though considered a musical genius and humorist, his greatest gift may have been his ability to connect with people. He channeled his many sides into fantastically absurd, touching and astute songwriting that still resonates today."

The exhibit will feature a short film produced by the museum and narrated by Country Music Hall of Fame member Marty Stuart. Visitors will see clothing, awards, handwritten notes, song manuscripts, instruments and rare footage of Miller's television appearances and performances.

Examples of items to be displayed include: 

  • Fiddle – When Miller was around 10 years old, musician and actor Sheb Wooley, who was married to Roger's cousin Melva at the time and lived nearby, bought him this fiddle.
  • Drawing – During his senior year in high school, Roger Miller drew this portrait of one of his musical heroes, Hank Williams.
  • Army shirt – Miller wore this shirt while serving in the U.S. Army from March 1954 to March 1957. He was stationed in South Korea for a time, where he drove a Jeep and played in a country band with other soldiers.
  • Guitar – This 1963 Gibson C-1E nylon-string model was Miller's primary guitar for most of the 1960s. He used it to write, record and perform many of his biggest hits, including "King of the Road."
  • Song manuscript and statuette – The credit card application, on which he started writing lyrics to "King of the Road," and a wood carving of a hobo, which inspired him to finish writing the song, are housed together in a shadow box built by Miller.
  • Grammy awards – Miller won 11 Grammy awards in 1965 and 1966. In addition to Miller's wins in nine country music categories, "King of the Road" earned him Grammys for Best Contemporary (Rock & Roll) Single and Best Contemporary (Rock & Roll) Vocal Performance, Male.
  • Hand-written notes – Roger Miller often wrote down song ideas and lyrics on scrap pieces of paper. Mary Miller, Roger's wife, called them his "droppings."
  • Motorcycle – Miller purchased this Honda CA95 Benly Touring 150 motorcycle in 1965, following his financial windfall with the success of "Dang Me," "Chug-a-Lug" and "King of the Road."
  • Western shirt – Miller wore this western shirt, designed by Manuel Cuevas, when he performed at a taping of "Roger Miller: A Soundstage Special" at WTTW Studios in Chicago in 1982.
  • Tony award and tuxedo – Miller won this Tony award for "Best Original Score (Music and/or Lyrics) Written for the Theatre" for the Broadway musical "Big River," for which he wrote all the songs. The musical won a total of seven Tonys. He wore this tuxedo at the 39th Annual Tony Awards, June 2, 1985.

Miller was inducted posthumously into the Country Music Hall of Fame in 1995. For more information on his life and career, read Miller's Country Music Hall of Fame bio.

Exhibit Companion Catalog

An illustrated and in-depth exhibit catalog will supplement the gallery presentation, featuring historical photographs and artifacts from the exhibit. It includes a foreword by Grammy award-winning artist Dwight Yoakam. The catalog is available through The Museum Store beginning Nov. 6. It is made possible through support from Maverick Nashville and will be widely available in bookstores and online outlets through a distribution partnership with the University of Illinois Press.

Exhibit Playlist

The official exhibit playlist, compiled by the museum's curatorial staff, is now available on major streaming platforms.

Upcoming Programs

In support of the exhibit, the museum will host a variety of public programs during its run. Upcoming programs include: 

  • Panel Discussion – Saturday, Nov. 7, at 2:30 p.m. (Ford Theater)

    The museum will host a conversation with some of the people who knew Miller best: the late musician's wife, Mary Miller, a former member of Kenny Rogers' band the First Edition; Country Music Hall of Fame member and Miller's close friend Bill Anderson, who first met Miller in Atlanta in the 1950s when both were struggling songwriters; and Randy Hart, Miller's musical director and bandleader of eight years who currently serves as staff pianist and assistant music director at the Grand Ole Opry. The talk will be hosted by the museum's exhibit co-curator Erin Osmon and illustrated with archival images, audio and video from the museum's collection.
  • Songwriter Session with Dean Miller – Saturday, Feb. 6, 2027, at noon (Ford Theater)

    Dean Miller is Roger's son and an accomplished singer and songwriter. He will perform and discuss some of his father's songs, as well as his own. During Songwriter Sessions at the museum, songwriters share stories and songs behind classic and current hits.

The programs are included with museum admission with reservations encouraged in advance. Visit the museum's website to reserve tickets and learn more about the exhibit.

About the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum:

The Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum collects, preserves and interprets country music and its history for the education and entertainment of diverse audiences. In exhibitions, publications, digital media and educational programs, the museum explores the cultural importance and enduring beauty of the art form. Among the most-visited history museums in the United States, the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum was awarded the country's highest honor in the arts, the National Medal of Arts, in 2024. Accredited by the American Alliance of Museums, the museum is operated by the Country Music Foundation, a not-for-profit 501(c)(3) educational organization chartered by the state of Tennessee in 1964. The Country Music Foundation operates Historic RCA Studio B®, Hatch Show Print® poster shop, Haley Gallery, CMA Theater, CMF Records, the Frist Library and Archive and CMF Press.

More information about the Country Music Hall of Fame® and Museum is available at www.countrymusichalloffame.org or by calling (615) 416-2001.

releases.title: THE RAIL IN LEXINGTON ANNOUNCES PEACHTREE ENTERTAINMENT AS CO-OWNER AND EXCLUSIVE OPERATOR, PLUS NEW RENDERINGS UNVEILED
releases.body:
PEACHTREE ENTERTAINMENT ANNOUNCED AS CO-OWNER AND EXCLUSIVE OPERATOR OF THE RAIL WITH FIRST SHOWS TO BE UNVEILED LATER THIS YEAR

LEXINGTON, Ky., Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- National concert promotion company Peachtree Entertainment, in partnership with The Commons, has been announced as co-owner and exclusive operator of The Rail, Lexington's forthcoming state-of-the-art live music venue within the Commons Entertainment District, designed to deliver exceptional experiences on both sides of the stage. Peachtree Entertainment will provide operations, marketing, sponsorship. select programming support and more. Brand new venue renderings were also unveiled today as well as plans to announce the first wave of shows later this year followed by a grand opening in early 2027. Music fans are encouraged to visit theraillex.com and follow the venue on social media (Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, etc.) for all of the latest news, announcements and updates.

Located within The Commons, the 43-acre mixed-use entertainment district one mile from downtown on Lexington & West Main Street, The Rail represents a major investment in Lexington's future as it attracts visitors, creates jobs and supports local businesses. Beyond Lexington, the venue is located within a day's drive of Nashville, Louisville, Cincinnati, Indianapolis, Columbus, Knoxville and St. Louis. "Lexington's cultural and entertainment scene is experiencing great momentum. The Commons is expanding what an evening or weekend in our city can look like, and The Rail anchors that vision with exceptional energy. A venue of this caliber amplifies our regional entertainment offerings, encourages visitors to stay longer, and gives our local community a premier space to gather," said VisitLex President, Mary Quinn Ramer.

With a capacity of 2,200 guests and more than 1,000 seats for theater-style events, The Rail brings the scale, flexibility, and production capabilities needed to host national touring artists while maintaining an intimate, high-energy experience. The venue features six full-service bars, two outdoor decks, premium VIP spaces, an exclusive membership program, ample restrooms, and a flexible floor plan designed for concerts, club nights, corporate functions, special events, and private rentals.

Designed with both the guest and artist experience in mind, The Rail pairs top-tier sound and production with three dedicated dressing rooms, an artist lounge, and thoughtfully designed backstage amenities. Together with the dining, entertainment, and hospitality offerings throughout The Commons, The Rail delivers a complete destination for live entertainment and private events in Lexington.

"We are excited and honored to be involved in this revitalization of Lexington. Every seat, every sightline, every bar, and every common area has been intentionally designed so fans feel close to the performance," said Dustin Labbe, SVP of Booking for Peachtree Entertainment. "Whether you're on the floor, in the mezzanine, or in a VIP space, the experience stays immersive. The Rail, located within a day's drive of other major midwest markets, is an ideal routing stop for national tours. That means more opportunities to bring artists, and the economic impact that comes with them, to Central Kentucky."

"What we've always wanted The Commons to become is a place where people can spend an entire day, and now an entire evening, without having to leave. The Rail brings that vision together," said Daren Turner, Founder of The Commons. "People can come for a show, have dinner beforehand, meet friends for drinks afterward, and stay just steps away from the venue. That kind of activity and connection is what turns a development into a true destination. We believe The Rail will not only become the heartbeat of The Commons, but an important part of Lexington's growing entertainment scene."

About The Commons

The Commons is a 43-acre mixed-use entertainment district in Lexington, Kentucky, built on a former tobacco processing campus one mile from downtown, with an active rail line running through the property. Restored warehouse buildings and new construction house dining, retail, recreation, studios, and luxury short-term stays, connected by walking trails and a central greenspace. More than thirty businesses already operate on the campus. The Commons is developed by Turner Properties.

About Peachtree Entertainment

Peachtree Entertainment is a nationally acclaimed concert promoter committed to spotlighting rising talent. With over 15 years of expertise in the music industry, Peachtree Entertainment has earned its reputation as a leader and innovator in live music. As pioneers in identifying and nurturing new talent, Peachtree Entertainment has played a key role in launching the touring careers of artists like Luke Combs, Morgan Wallen, Luke Bryan, Ella Langley, and many more. Beyond tours, Peachtree's portfolio also features major festivals and key partnerships with venues and universities across the country.

Peachtree Entertainment remains dedicated to shaping the national live music scene, continuing its legacy of significant influence and success. To learn more information about Peachtree Entertainment tours and events, click here, or follow on Instagram or Facebook.

Musically directed by GRAMMY® Award winning songwriter Pynk Beard, the album brings together Brandy, Keb' Mo', Kashus Culpepper, Elsie, 2'Live Bre, Reyna Roberts, Tone Stith and more for new interpretations of songs that defined an era
